### `apps/api/src/attendance/attendance.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  BadRequestException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { toCsv } from '../common/utils/csv.util';
import { haversineDistanceMeters } from '../common/utils/geo.util';
import { euclideanDistance } from '../common/utils/face.util';
import { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { EnrollFaceDto } from './dto/enroll-face.dto';
import { CheckInDto } from './dto/check-in.dto';
import { CheckOutDto } from './dto/check-out.dto';
import { QueryAttendanceDto } from './dto/query-attendance.dto';
import { QueryAttendanceReportDto } from './dto/query-attendance-report.dto';
import { CreateOfficeLocationDto } from './dto/create-office-location.dto';
import { UpdateOfficeLocationDto } from './dto/update-office-location.dto';

type ReadScope = 'all' | 'department' | 'own';

/** Số dòng tối đa xuất ra CSV một lần */
const CSV_EXPORT_LIMIT = 5000;

@Injectable()
export class AttendanceService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Cấu hình (env, có giá trị mặc định hợp lý cho môi trường dev)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Ngưỡng khoảng cách Euclidean tối đa để coi là cùng một người (face-api.js) */
  private matchThreshold(): number {
    const raw = Number(process.env.FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD);
    return Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : 0.6;
  }

  private workStart(): string {
    return process.env.ATTENDANCE_WORK_START ?? '08:30';
  }

  private workEnd(): string {
    return process.env.ATTENDANCE_WORK_END ?? '17:30';
  }

  private parseHHMM(value: string): number {
    const [h, m] = value.split(':').map((x) => Number(x));
    return (h || 0) * 60 + (m || 0);
  }

  /** Lấy các thành phần ngày/giờ theo múi giờ Việt Nam (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh),
   *  BẤT KỂ múi giờ hệ điều hành của máy chủ là gì.
   *
   *  Quan trọng: ATTENDANCE_WORK_START/END ("08:30"/"17:30" theo mặc định)
   *  là giờ hành chính Việt Nam, nhưng trước đây minutesOfDay()/todayDate()
   *  dùng getUTCHours()/Date.UTC() — đúng ở máy dev (thường chạy giờ địa
   *  phương VN trùng ngẫu nhiên) nhưng SAI khi triển khai production (server
   *  container thường chạy UTC): một nhân viên chấm công lúc 8:30 sáng giờ
   *  VN là 1:30 sáng UTC, nên không bao giờ bị đánh dấu "đi trễ" dù có đi
   *  trễ thật, và mốc ngày công (date key) bị lệch tới 7 tiếng — chấm công
   *  từ 00:00-06:59 giờ VN sẽ bị ghi nhận vào NGÀY HÔM TRƯỚC. */
  private vnParts(d: Date): {
    year: number;
    month: number;
    day: number;
    hour: number;
    minute: number;
  } {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hourCycle: 'h23',
    }).formatToParts(d);
    const get = (type: string) =>
      Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value ?? 0);
    return {
      year: get('year'),
      month: get('month'),
      day: get('day'),
      hour: get('hour'),
      minute: get('minute'),
    };
  }

  private minutesOfDay(d: Date): number {
    const { hour, minute } = this.vnParts(d);
    return hour * 60 + minute;
  }

  private todayDate(): Date {
    const { year, month, day } = this.vnParts(new Date());
    // Intl trả về tháng dạng 1-based, Date.UTC cần dạng 0-based.
    return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Trợ giúp chung
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  private async resolveEmployee(userId: string) {
    const employee = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { userId, archivedAt: null },
    });
    if (!employee) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Tài khoản của bạn chưa được liên kết với hồ sơ nhân viên.',
      );
    }
    return employee;
  }

  /** Xác thực GPS: hợp lệ nếu nằm trong bán kính của bất kỳ văn phòng active nào.
   *  Nếu hệ thống chưa cấu hình văn phòng nào, bỏ qua kiểm tra (cho môi trường dev/demo). */
  private async validateGeofence(latitude: number, longitude: number) {
    const offices = await this.prisma.officeLocation.findMany({
      where: { isActive: true },
    });
    if (offices.length === 0) return;

    const withinAny = offices.some(
      (o: any) =>
        haversineDistanceMeters(
          latitude,
          longitude,
          Number(o.latitude),
          Number(o.longitude),
        ) <= o.radiusMeters,
    );
    if (!withinAny) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Bạn đang ở ngoài khu vực văn phòng cho phép chấm công.',
      );
    }
  }

  /** Xác thực khuôn mặt so với descriptor đã đăng ký, trả về điểm khớp (0–1) */
  private matchFace(employee: any, descriptor: number[]): number {
    if (!employee.faceEncoding) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Bạn chưa đăng ký khuôn mặt. Vui lòng đăng ký trước khi chấm công.',
      );
    }
    const stored = employee.faceEncoding as number[];
    const distance = euclideanDistance(stored, descriptor);
    if (distance > this.matchThreshold()) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Khuôn mặt không khớp với dữ liệu đã đăng ký.',
      );
    }
    return Math.max(0, 1 - distance);
  }

  private mapRecord(r: any) {
    return {
      id: r.id,
      employeeId: r.employeeId,
      employee: r.employee
        ? {
            id: r.employee.id,
            code: r.employee.code,
            fullName: r.employee.fullName,
            avatarUrl: r.employee.avatarUrl,
            department: r.employee.department
              ? {
                  id: r.employee.department.id,
                  name: r.employee.department.name,
                }
              : null,
          }
        : undefined,
      date: r.date,
      checkInAt: r.checkInAt,
      checkInLocation:
        r.checkInLatitude != null
          ? {
              latitude: Number(r.checkInLatitude),
              longitude: Number(r.checkInLongitude),
            }
          : null,
      checkInPhotoUrl: r.checkInPhotoUrl ?? null,
      checkInMatchScore:
        r.checkInMatchScore != null ? Number(r.checkInMatchScore) : null,
      checkInSource: r.checkInSource ?? null,
      checkOutAt: r.checkOutAt,
      checkOutLocation:
        r.checkOutLatitude != null
          ? {
              latitude: Number(r.checkOutLatitude),
              longitude: Number(r.checkOutLongitude),
            }
          : null,
      checkOutPhotoUrl: r.checkOutPhotoUrl ?? null,
      checkOutMatchScore:
        r.checkOutMatchScore != null ? Number(r.checkOutMatchScore) : null,
      checkOutSource: r.checkOutSource ?? null,
      status: r.status,
      note: r.note ?? null,
    };
  }

  private readScope(user: RequestUser): ReadScope {
    if (user.permissions?.some((p) => p.startsWith('attendance:read:all')))
      return 'all';
    if (
      user.permissions?.some((p) => p.startsWith('attendance:read:department'))
    ) {
      return 'department';
    }
    return 'own';
  }

  private async buildScopedWhere(user: RequestUser, query: QueryAttendanceDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    const scope = this.readScope(user);

    const where: any = {};
    if (scope === 'own') {
      where.employeeId = employee.id;
    } else if (scope === 'department') {
      where.employee = { departmentId: employee.departmentId };
    } else {
      if (query.employeeId) where.employeeId = query.employeeId;
      if (query.departmentId)
        where.employee = { departmentId: query.departmentId };
    }

    if (query.dateFrom || query.dateTo) {
      where.date = {};
      if (query.dateFrom) where.date.gte = new Date(query.dateFrom);
      if (query.dateTo) where.date.lte = new Date(query.dateTo);
    }

    return where;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Đăng ký khuôn mặt & chấm công
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async enrollFace(userId: string, dto: EnrollFaceDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(userId);
    await this.prisma.employee.update({
      where: { id: employee.id },
      data: { faceEncoding: dto.descriptor },
    });
    return { success: true, message: 'Đã đăng ký khuôn mặt thành công.' };
  }

  async checkIn(userId: string, dto: CheckInDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(userId);
    await this.validateGeofence(dto.latitude, dto.longitude);
    const score = this.matchFace(employee, dto.descriptor);

    const date = this.todayDate();
    const existing = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findUnique({
      where: { employeeId_date: { employeeId: employee.id, date } },
    });
    if (existing?.checkInAt) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Bạn đã chấm công vào hôm nay rồi.');
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const status =
      this.minutesOfDay(now) > this.parseHHMM(this.workStart())
        ? 'late'
        : 'present';

    const data = {
      checkInAt: now,
      checkInLatitude: dto.latitude,
      checkInLongitude: dto.longitude,
      checkInPhotoUrl: dto.photoUrl ?? null,
      checkInMatchScore: score,
      checkInSource: dto.source ?? 'web',
      status,
      note: dto.note ?? existing?.note ?? null,
    };

    const record = existing
      ? await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.update({
          where: { id: existing.id },
          data,
        })
      : await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.create({
          data: { employeeId: employee.id, date, ...data },
        });

    return this.mapRecord(record);
  }

  async checkOut(userId: string, dto: CheckOutDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(userId);
    await this.validateGeofence(dto.latitude, dto.longitude);
    const score = this.matchFace(employee, dto.descriptor);

    const date = this.todayDate();
    const existing = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findUnique({
      where: { employeeId_date: { employeeId: employee.id, date } },
    });
    if (!existing?.checkInAt) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Bạn chưa chấm công vào hôm nay.');
    }
    if (existing.checkOutAt) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Bạn đã chấm công ra hôm nay rồi.');
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const isEarly = this.minutesOfDay(now) < this.parseHHMM(this.workEnd());
    const status = isEarly ? 'early_leave' : existing.status;

    const record = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.update({
      where: { id: existing.id },
      data: {
        checkOutAt: now,
        checkOutLatitude: dto.latitude,
        checkOutLongitude: dto.longitude,
        checkOutPhotoUrl: dto.photoUrl ?? null,
        checkOutMatchScore: score,
        checkOutSource: dto.source ?? 'web',
        status,
        note: dto.note ?? existing.note ?? null,
      },
    });

    return this.mapRecord(record);
  }

  async today(userId: string) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(userId);
    const date = this.todayDate();
    const record = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findUnique({
      where: { employeeId_date: { employeeId: employee.id, date } },
    });
    return {
      hasFaceEnrolled: !!employee.faceEncoding,
      record: record ? this.mapRecord(record) : null,
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Danh sách / xuất CSV / báo cáo tháng
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async findAll(user: RequestUser, query: QueryAttendanceDto) {
    const where = await this.buildScopedWhere(user, query);

    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 200);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          employee: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              code: true,
              fullName: true,
              avatarUrl: true,
              department: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }, { checkInAt: 'desc' }],
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRecord(r)),
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  async exportCsv(
    user: RequestUser,
    query: QueryAttendanceDto,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const where = await this.buildScopedWhere(user, query);
    const rows = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        employee: {
          select: {
            code: true,
            fullName: true,
            department: { select: { name: true } },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }],
      take: CSV_EXPORT_LIMIT,
    });

    return toCsv(
      [
        'Ngày',
        'Mã NV',
        'Họ tên',
        'Phòng ban',
        'Giờ vào',
        'Giờ ra',
        'Trạng thái',
        'Ghi chú',
      ],
      rows.map((r: any) => [
        r.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        r.employee?.code ?? '',
        r.employee?.fullName ?? '',
        r.employee?.department?.name ?? '',
        r.checkInAt ? r.checkInAt.toISOString().slice(11, 16) : '',
        r.checkOutAt ? r.checkOutAt.toISOString().slice(11, 16) : '',
        r.status,
        r.note ?? '',
      ]),
    );
  }

  async monthlyReport(user: RequestUser, query: QueryAttendanceReportDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    const scope = this.readScope(user);

    const now = new Date();
    const month =
      query.month ??
      `${now.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');
    const year = Number(yearStr);
    const monthIndex = Number(monthStr) - 1;
    const gte = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex, 1));
    const lt = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex + 1, 1));

    const employeeWhere: any = { archivedAt: null };
    if (scope === 'own') {
      employeeWhere.id = employee.id;
    } else if (scope === 'department') {
      employeeWhere.departmentId = employee.departmentId;
    } else {
      if (query.employeeId) employeeWhere.id = query.employeeId;
      if (query.departmentId) employeeWhere.departmentId = query.departmentId;
    }

    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: employeeWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        code: true,
        fullName: true,
        department: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { fullName: 'asc' },
    });
    const employeeIds = employees.map((e: any) => e.id);
    if (employeeIds.length === 0) return { month, data: [] };

    const records = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: { employeeId: { in: employeeIds }, date: { gte, lt } },
      select: { employeeId: true, status: true },
    });

    const data = employees.map((e: any) => {
      const rs = records.filter((r: any) => r.employeeId === e.id);
      return {
        id: e.id,
        code: e.code,
        fullName: e.fullName,
        department: e.department
          ? { id: e.department.id, name: e.department.name }
          : null,
        daysPresent: rs.filter((r: any) => r.status === 'present').length,
        daysLate: rs.filter((r: any) => r.status === 'late').length,
        daysEarlyLeave: rs.filter((r: any) => r.status === 'early_leave')
          .length,
        totalRecorded: rs.length,
      };
    });

    return { month, data };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Quản lý vị trí văn phòng (geofence) — chỉ admin/hr
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async listOffices() {
    const offices = await this.prisma.officeLocation.findMany({
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
    return offices.map((o: any) => ({
      ...o,
      latitude: Number(o.latitude),
      longitude: Number(o.longitude),
    }));
  }

  async createOffice(dto: CreateOfficeLocationDto) {
    const office = await this.prisma.officeLocation.create({
      data: {
        name: dto.name,
        address: dto.address ?? null,
        latitude: dto.latitude,
        longitude: dto.longitude,
        radiusMeters: dto.radiusMeters ?? 200,
        isActive: dto.isActive ?? true,
      },
    });
    return {
      ...office,
      latitude: Number(office.latitude),
      longitude: Number(office.longitude),
    };
  }

  async updateOffice(id: string, dto: UpdateOfficeLocationDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.officeLocation.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy văn phòng.');

    const data: any = {};
    if (dto.name !== undefined) data.name = dto.name;
    if (dto.address !== undefined) data.address = dto.address || null;
    if (dto.latitude !== undefined) data.latitude = dto.latitude;
    if (dto.longitude !== undefined) data.longitude = dto.longitude;
    if (dto.radiusMeters !== undefined) data.radiusMeters = dto.radiusMeters;
    if (dto.isActive !== undefined) data.isActive = dto.isActive;

    const office = await this.prisma.officeLocation.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
    });
    return {
      ...office,
      latitude: Number(office.latitude),
      longitude: Number(office.longitude),
    };
  }

  async removeOffice(id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.officeLocation.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy văn phòng.');

    await this.prisma.officeLocation.delete({ where: { id } });
    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa văn phòng.' };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { AuditController } from './audit.controller';
import { AuditService } from './audit.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../common/guards/roles.guard';

describe('AuditController', () => {
  let controller: AuditController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;

  const buildRes = () => {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    return {
      header: jest.fn((key: string, value: string) => {
        headers[key] = value;
      }),
      headers,
    } as any;
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      exportCsv: jest.fn(),
      meta: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [AuditController],
      providers: [{ provide: AuditService, useValue: service }],
    })
      .overrideGuard(JwtAuthGuard)
      .useValue({ canActivate: () => true })
      .overrideGuard(RolesGuard)
      .useValue({ canActivate: () => true })
      .compile();

    controller = module.get(AuditController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('delegates to the JSON listing by default', async () => {
      const query = { page: 1 } as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], total: 0 });

      const result = await controller.findAll(query, res);

      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(service.exportCsv).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result).toEqual({ data: [], total: 0 });
      expect(res.header).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('streams a CSV download when format=csv', async () => {
      const query = { format: 'csv' } as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.exportCsv.mockResolvedValue('csv-content');

      const result = await controller.findAll(query, res);

      expect(service.exportCsv).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(service.findAll).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result).toBe('csv-content');
      expect(res.headers['Content-Type']).toBe('text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      expect(res.headers['Content-Disposition']).toContain(
        'nhat-ky-he-thong.csv',
      );
    });
  });

  describe('meta', () => {
    it('delegates to the service', async () => {
      service.meta.mockResolvedValue({ actions: [], resourceTypes: [] });

      const result = await controller.meta();

      expect(service.meta).toHaveBeenCalledWith();
      expect(result).toEqual({ actions: [], resourceTypes: [] });
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/audit/audit.controller.ts`

```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Query, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { AuditService } from './audit.service';
import { QueryAuditLogDto } from './dto/query-audit-log.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

/**
 * Nhật ký hệ thống (Audit Log) — chỉ admin được xem, vì dữ liệu ghi lại toàn
 * bộ thao tác tạo/sửa/xóa của mọi người dùng trong hệ thống.
 */
@ApiTags('audit-log')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('audit-logs')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles('admin')
export class AuditController {
  constructor(private readonly auditService: AuditService) {}

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Danh sách nhật ký hệ thống (phân trang, lọc, tìm kiếm)',
  })
  async findAll(
    @Query() query: QueryAuditLogDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    if (query.format === 'csv') {
      const csv = await this.auditService.exportCsv(query);
      res.header('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.header(
        'Content-Disposition',
        'attachment; filename="nhat-ky-he-thong.csv"',
      );
      return csv;
    }
    return this.auditService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('meta')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Danh sách hành động & loại đối tượng đã ghi nhận (phục vụ bộ lọc)',
  })
  async meta() {
    return this.auditService.meta();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { AuditService } from './audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

type MockPrisma = {
  auditLog: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  $transaction: jest.Mock;
};

describe('AuditService', () => {
  let service: AuditService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      auditLog: { create: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn(), count: jest.fn() },
      $transaction: jest.fn((ops: Promise<any>[]) => Promise.all(ops)),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [AuditService, { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma }],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(AuditService);
    jest.spyOn(service['logger'], 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('log', () => {
    it('writes an entry with all fields, falling back to null for missing optional fields', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      await service.log({ action: 'create', userId: 'u1' });

      expect(prisma.auditLog.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        data: {
          userId: 'u1',
          userEmail: null,
          action: 'create',
          resourceType: null,
          resourceId: null,
          oldValues: undefined,
          newValues: undefined,
          ipAddress: null,
          userAgent: null,
        },
      });
    });

    it('writes an entry with every field populated', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      await service.log({
        userId: 'u1',
        userEmail: 'a@b.com',
        action: 'update',
        resourceType: 'departments',
        resourceId: 'd1',
        oldValues: { name: 'A' },
        newValues: { name: 'B' },
        ipAddress: '1.2.3.4',
        userAgent: 'jest',
      });

      expect(prisma.auditLog.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        data: {
          userId: 'u1',
          userEmail: 'a@b.com',
          action: 'update',
          resourceType: 'departments',
          resourceId: 'd1',
          oldValues: { name: 'A' },
          newValues: { name: 'B' },
          ipAddress: '1.2.3.4',
          userAgent: 'jest',
        },
      });
    });

    it('swallows and logs write errors so the caller flow is never broken', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.create.mockRejectedValue(new Error('DB down'));

      await expect(service.log({ action: 'create' })).resolves.toBeUndefined();
      expect(service['logger'].error).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('paginates with no filters', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([{ id: '1' }]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.findAll({} as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ where: {}, skip: 0, take: 20 }),
      );
      expect(result).toEqual({
        data: [{ id: '1' }],
        total: 1,
        page: 1,
        pageSize: 20,
        totalPages: 1,
      });
    });

    it('applies userId, resourceType, and action filters', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({
        userId: 'u1',
        resourceType: 'departments',
        action: 'create',
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: {
            userId: 'u1',
            resourceType: 'departments',
            action: 'create',
          },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies a dateFrom-only range filter', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ dateFrom: '2026-01-01' } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { createdAt: { gte: new Date('2026-01-01') } },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies a dateTo-only range filter', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ dateTo: '2026-01-31' } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { createdAt: { lte: new Date('2026-01-31') } },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies a search filter across userEmail and resourceId', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ search: '  ken@comtech.vn  ' } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: {
            OR: [
              {
                userEmail: { contains: 'ken@comtech.vn', mode: 'insensitive' },
              },
              {
                resourceId: { contains: 'ken@comtech.vn', mode: 'insensitive' },
              },
            ],
          },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('ignores a blank search string', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ search: '   ' } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ where: {} }),
      );
    });

    it('clamps page and pageSize to sane bounds', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.auditLog.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ page: -5, pageSize: 999 } as any);

      expect(prisma.auditLog.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ skip: 0, take: 200 }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('meta', () => {
    it('returns distinct actions and resource types', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ action: 'create' }, { action: 'update' }])
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([
          { resourceType: 'departments' },
          { resourceType: 'employees' },
        ]);

      const result = await service.meta();

      expect(result).toEqual({
        actions: ['create', 'update'],
        resourceTypes: ['departments', 'employees'],
      });
    });
  });

  describe('exportCsv', () => {
    it('renders matching rows as CSV', async () => {
      prisma.auditLog.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T10:00:00Z'),
          userEmail: 'a@b.com',
          action: 'create',
          resourceType: 'departments',
          resourceId: 'd1',
          ipAddress: '1.2.3.4',
        },
        {
          createdAt: new Date('2026-01-02T10:00:00Z'),
          userEmail: null,
          action: 'delete',
          resourceType: null,
          resourceId: null,
          ipAddress: null,
        },
      ]);

      const csv = await service.exportCsv({} as any);

      expect(csv).toContain('a@b.com,create,departments,d1,1.2.3.4');
      expect(csv).toContain(',delete,,,');
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/audit/audit.service.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { toCsv } from '../common/utils/csv.util';
import { QueryAuditLogDto } from './dto/query-audit-log.dto';

export interface AuditEntry {
  userId?: string | null;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  action: string;
  resourceType?: string | null;
  resourceId?: string | null;
  oldValues?: any;
  newValues?: any;
  ipAddress?: string | null;
  userAgent?: string | null;
}

/** Số dòng tối đa xuất ra CSV một lần, tránh tải quá nhiều dữ liệu vào bộ nhớ */
const CSV_EXPORT_LIMIT = 5000;

@Injectable()
export class AuditService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('AuditLog');

  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async log(entry: AuditEntry): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.prisma.auditLog.create({
        data: {
          userId: entry.userId ?? null,
          userEmail: entry.userEmail ?? null,
          action: entry.action,
          resourceType: entry.resourceType ?? null,
          resourceId: entry.resourceId ?? null,
          oldValues: entry.oldValues ?? undefined,
          newValues: entry.newValues ?? undefined,
          ipAddress: entry.ipAddress ?? null,
          userAgent: entry.userAgent ?? null,
        },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // Không để lỗi ghi nhật ký làm hỏng luồng chính
      this.logger.error(`Không ghi được audit log: ${(err as Error).message}`);
    }
  }

  private buildWhere(query: QueryAuditLogDto): any {
    const where: any = {};
    if (query.userId) where.userId = query.userId;
    if (query.resourceType) where.resourceType = query.resourceType;
    if (query.action) where.action = query.action;

    if (query.dateFrom || query.dateTo) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (query.dateFrom) where.createdAt.gte = new Date(query.dateFrom);
      if (query.dateTo) where.createdAt.lte = new Date(query.dateTo);
    }

    if (query.search && query.search.trim()) {
      const term = query.search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { userEmail: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { resourceId: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    return where;
  }

  /** Danh sách nhật ký hệ thống, có phân trang và lọc (chỉ admin) */
  async findAll(query: QueryAuditLogDto) {
    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 200);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;
    const where = this.buildWhere(query);

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.auditLog.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows,
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  /** Danh sách hành động & loại đối tượng khác nhau đã từng ghi nhận (phục vụ bộ lọc) */
  async meta() {
    const [actions, resourceTypes] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({
        distinct: ['action'],
        select: { action: true },
        orderBy: { action: 'asc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({
        distinct: ['resourceType'],
        select: { resourceType: true },
        where: { resourceType: { not: null } },
        orderBy: { resourceType: 'asc' },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      actions: actions.map((a) => a.action),
      resourceTypes: resourceTypes.map((r) => r.resourceType as string),
    };
  }

  async exportCsv(query: QueryAuditLogDto): Promise<string> {
    const where = this.buildWhere(query);
    const rows = await this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: CSV_EXPORT_LIMIT,
    });

    return toCsv(
      [
        'Thời gian',
        'Người dùng',
        'Hành động',
        'Loại đối tượng',
        'ID đối tượng',
        'Địa chỉ IP',
      ],
      rows.map((r) => [
        r.createdAt.toISOString(),
        r.userEmail ?? '',
        r.action,
        r.resourceType ?? '',
        r.resourceId ?? '',
        r.ipAddress ?? '',
      ]),
    );
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/audit/dto/query-audit-log.dto.ts`

```typescript
import {
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsISO8601,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  Max,
  Min,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';

export type AuditLogFormat = 'json' | 'csv';

/**
 * Bộ lọc cho danh sách nhật ký hệ thống (Audit Log): theo người dùng, loại
 * đối tượng, hành động, và khoảng thời gian. Chỉ admin được truy cập vì dữ
 * liệu này có thể chứa thông tin nhạy cảm về hoạt động của người khác.
 */
export class QueryAuditLogDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID()
  userId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  resourceType?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  action?: string;

  /** Ngày bắt đầu (bao gồm), định dạng ISO 8601 */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsISO8601()
  dateFrom?: string;

  /** Ngày kết thúc (bao gồm), định dạng ISO 8601 */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsISO8601()
  dateTo?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  search?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 1))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  page?: number = 1;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 20))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(200)
  pageSize?: number = 20;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['json', 'csv'])
  format?: AuditLogFormat = 'json';
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { ThrottlerGuard } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

describe('AuthController', () => {
  let controller: AuthController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;

  const buildRes = () => {
    const cookies: Record<string, { value: string; options: any }> = {};
    const cleared: Record<string, any> = {};
    return {
      cookie: jest.fn((name: string, value: string, options: any) => {
        cookies[name] = { value, options };
      }),
      clearCookie: jest.fn((name: string, options: any) => {
        cleared[name] = options;
      }),
      cookies,
      cleared,
    } as any;
  };

  const buildReq = (overrides: Partial<any> = {}) =>
    ({
      headers: {},
      cookies: {},
      ip: '127.0.0.1',
      ...overrides,
    }) as any;

  const user: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'u1',
    email: 'a@b.com',
    roles: ['employee'],
    permissions: [],
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      login: jest.fn(),
      refresh: jest.fn(),
      logout: jest.fn(),
      forgotPassword: jest.fn(),
      resetPassword: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [AuthController],
      providers: [{ provide: AuthService, useValue: service }],
    })
      .overrideGuard(JwtAuthGuard)
      .useValue({ canActivate: () => true })
      .overrideGuard(ThrottlerGuard)
      .useValue({ canActivate: () => true })
      .compile();

    controller = module.get(AuthController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('login', () => {
    it('sets the refresh cookie and returns accessToken/expiresIn/user only', async () => {
      service.login.mockResolvedValue({
        accessToken: 'access-1',
        refreshToken: 'user-1.raw',
        expiresIn: 900,
        user: { id: 'u1' },
      });
      const req = buildReq();
      const res = buildRes();

      const result = await controller.login(
        { email: 'a@b.com', password: 'pw' } as any,
        req,
        res,
      );

      expect(service.login).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@b.com', 'pw', {
        ip: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: null,
      });
      expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'comtech_refresh',
        'user-1.raw',
        expect.objectContaining({
          httpOnly: true,
          path: '/api/auth',
          sameSite: 'lax',
        }),
      );
      expect(result).toEqual({
        accessToken: 'access-1',
        expiresIn: 900,
        user: { id: 'u1' },
      });
      expect((result as any).refreshToken).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('extracts ip from x-forwarded-for in preference to req.ip', async () => {
      service.login.mockResolvedValue({
        accessToken: 'a',
        refreshToken: 'r',
        expiresIn: 1,
        user: {},
      });
      const req = buildReq({
        headers: { 'x-forwarded-for': '1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.2' },
      });
      const res = buildRes();

      await controller.login(
        { email: 'a@b.com', password: 'pw' } as any,
        req,
        res,
      );

      expect(service.login).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@b.com', 'pw', {
        ip: '1.1.1.1',
        userAgent: null,
      });
    });
  });

  describe('refresh', () => {
    it('reads the refresh cookie, rotates it, and returns the new tokens', async () => {
      service.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
        accessToken: 'access-2',
        refreshToken: 'user-1.raw2',
        expiresIn: 900,
        user: { id: 'u1' },
      });
      const req = buildReq({ cookies: { comtech_refresh: 'user-1.old' } });
      const res = buildRes();

      const result = await controller.refresh(req, res);

      expect(service.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1.old', {
        ip: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: null,
      });
      expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'comtech_refresh',
        'user-1.raw2',
        expect.any(Object),
      );
      expect(result).toEqual({
        accessToken: 'access-2',
        expiresIn: 900,
        user: { id: 'u1' },
      });
    });
  });

  describe('logout', () => {
    it('clears the refresh cookie and delegates to the service', async () => {
      service.logout.mockResolvedValue({ message: 'Đăng xuất thành công.' });
      const req = buildReq({ cookies: { comtech_refresh: 'user-1.raw' } });
      const res = buildRes();

      const result = await controller.logout(user, req, res);

      expect(service.logout).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'u1',
        'a@b.com',
        'user-1.raw',
        {
          ip: '127.0.0.1',
          userAgent: null,
        },
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith('comtech_refresh', {
        path: '/api/auth',
      });
      expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'Đăng xuất thành công.' });
    });

    it('tolerates a missing current user (defensive)', async () => {
      service.logout.mockResolvedValue({ message: 'ok' });
      const req = buildReq();
      const res = buildRes();

      await controller.logout(undefined as any, req, res);

      expect(service.logout).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        expect.any(Object),
      );
    });
  });

  it('delegates forgotPassword() to the service', async () => {
    service.forgotPassword.mockResolvedValue({ message: 'ok' });
    const req = buildReq();

    const result = await controller.forgotPassword(
      { email: 'a@b.com' } as any,
      req,
    );

    expect(service.forgotPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@b.com', {
      ip: '127.0.0.1',
      userAgent: null,
    });
    expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'ok' });
  });

  it('delegates resetPassword() to the service', async () => {
    service.resetPassword.mockResolvedValue({ message: 'ok' });
    const req = buildReq();

    const result = await controller.resetPassword(
      { token: 'tok', newPassword: 'NewPass123' } as any,
      req,
    );

    expect(service.resetPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith('tok', 'NewPass123', {
      ip: '127.0.0.1',
      userAgent: null,
    });
    expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'ok' });
  });

  describe('refresh cookie Secure flag (fail-safe defaults)', () => {
    const ORIGINAL_ENV = process.env;

    beforeEach(() => {
      process.env = { ...ORIGINAL_ENV };
      delete process.env.COOKIE_SECURE;
      delete process.env.NODE_ENV;
    });

    afterEach(() => {
      process.env = ORIGINAL_ENV;
    });

    const loginAndGetCookieOptions = async () => {
      service.login.mockResolvedValue({
        accessToken: 'access-1',
        refreshToken: 'user-1.raw',
        expiresIn: 900,
        user: { id: 'u1' },
      });
      const req = buildReq();
      const res = buildRes();
      await controller.login(
        { email: 'a@b.com', password: 'pw' } as any,
        req,
        res,
      );
      return res.cookie.mock.calls[0][2];
    };

    it('defaults Secure to true when NODE_ENV=production and COOKIE_SECURE is unset', async () => {
      process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production';
      const options = await loginAndGetCookieOptions();
      expect(options.secure).toBe(true);
    });

    it('defaults Secure to false when NODE_ENV is not production and COOKIE_SECURE is unset', async () => {
      process.env.NODE_ENV = 'development';
      const options = await loginAndGetCookieOptions();
      expect(options.secure).toBe(false);
    });

    it('respects an explicit COOKIE_SECURE=false even in production', async () => {
      process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production';
      process.env.COOKIE_SECURE = 'false';
      const options = await loginAndGetCookieOptions();
      expect(options.secure).toBe(false);
    });

    it('respects an explicit COOKIE_SECURE=true even outside production', async () => {
      process.env.NODE_ENV = 'development';
      process.env.COOKIE_SECURE = 'true';
      const options = await loginAndGetCookieOptions();
      expect(options.secure).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/auth/auth.controller.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Post,
  Req,
  Res,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { Throttle, ThrottlerGuard } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiTags,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { LoginDto, ForgotPasswordDto, ResetPasswordDto } from './dto/auth.dto';
import { Public } from '../common/decorators/public.decorator';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  RequestUser,
} from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

const REFRESH_COOKIE = 'comtech_refresh';

// Rate limit: tối đa 10 request/phút cho các endpoint auth
@ApiTags('auth')
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 10, ttl: 60_000 } })
@UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard)
@Controller('auth')
export class AuthController {
  constructor(private readonly authService: AuthService) {}

  private getMeta(req: Request) {
    return {
      ip:
        (req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] as string)?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ??
        req.ip ??
        null,
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] ?? null,
    };
  }

  private isSecureCookie(): boolean {
    // Mặc định an toàn: bật Secure ở mọi nơi TRỪ KHI người vận hành khai báo
    // rõ ràng COOKIE_SECURE=false (ví dụ khi chạy dev trên http://localhost).
    // Trước đây mặc định là false — nếu quên đặt biến môi trường này ở
    // production, cookie refresh token sẽ bị gửi qua HTTP không mã hóa mà
    // không có cảnh báo nào. Giờ đây quên cấu hình sẽ nghiêng về phía an
    // toàn hơn (bật Secure) thay vì phía kém an toàn hơn.
    if (process.env.COOKIE_SECURE !== undefined) {
      return process.env.COOKIE_SECURE === 'true';
    }
    return process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  }

  private setRefreshCookie(res: Response, token: string) {
    res.cookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, token, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: this.isSecureCookie(),
      sameSite: 'lax',
      path: '/api/auth',
      maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 ngày
    });
  }

  @Public()
  @Post('login')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Đăng nhập bằng email/mật khẩu, nhận access token' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Đăng nhập thành công' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: 'Sai thông tin đăng nhập hoặc tài khoản bị khóa',
  })
  async login(
    @Body() dto: LoginDto,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const result = await this.authService.login(
      dto.email,
      dto.password,
      this.getMeta(req),
    );
    this.setRefreshCookie(res, result.refreshToken);
    return {
      accessToken: result.accessToken,
      expiresIn: result.expiresIn,
      user: result.user,
    };
  }

  @Public()
  @Post('refresh')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Làm mới access token bằng refresh token (cookie)' })
  async refresh(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const token = req.cookies?.[REFRESH_COOKIE];
    const result = await this.authService.refresh(token, this.getMeta(req));
    this.setRefreshCookie(res, result.refreshToken);
    return {
      accessToken: result.accessToken,
      expiresIn: result.expiresIn,
      user: result.user,
    };
  }

  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @Post('logout')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Đăng xuất, thu hồi refresh token hiện tại' })
  async logout(
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const token = req.cookies?.[REFRESH_COOKIE];
    const result = await this.authService.logout(
      user?.userId,
      user?.email,
      token,
      this.getMeta(req),
    );
    res.clearCookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, { path: '/api/auth' });
    return result;
  }

  @Public()
  @Post('forgot-password')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu (nếu email tồn tại)' })
  async forgotPassword(@Body() dto: ForgotPasswordDto, @Req() req: Request) {
    return this.authService.forgotPassword(dto.email, this.getMeta(req));
  }

  @Public()
  @Post('reset-password')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Đặt lại mật khẩu bằng token nhận qua email' })
  async resetPassword(@Body() dto: ResetPasswordDto, @Req() req: Request) {
    return this.authService.resetPassword(
      dto.token,
      dto.newPassword,
      this.getMeta(req),
    );
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/auth/auth.module.ts`

```typescript
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtModule } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { PassportModule } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { JwtStrategy } from './jwt.strategy';

@Module({
  imports: [
    PassportModule,
    // Lưu ý: mọi lời gọi jwt.sign() thực tế đều tự truyền secret riêng
    // (xem AuthService.signAccessToken) nên secret đăng ký ở đây chỉ là giá
    // trị mặc định dự phòng — không dùng chuỗi cố định, tránh gây hiểu nhầm
    // rằng đây là secret đang thực sự bảo vệ token.
    JwtModule.register({
      secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET as string,
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AuthController],
  providers: [AuthService, JwtStrategy],
  exports: [AuthService],
})
export class AuthModule {}
```

### `apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.spec.ts`

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';

jest.mock('bcrypt', () => ({
  compare: jest.fn(),
  hash: jest.fn(),
}));

describe('AuthService', () => {
  let service: AuthService;
  let prisma: any;
  let jwt: any;
  let audit: any;

  const meta = { ip: '127.0.0.1', userAgent: 'jest' };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      user: { findUnique: jest.fn(), update: jest.fn() },
      refreshToken: {
        create: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
        updateMany: jest.fn(),
      },
      passwordResetToken: {
        create: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
      },
      $transaction: jest.fn(),
    };
    jwt = { sign: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('signed.jwt.token') };
    audit = { log: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        AuthService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwt },
        { provide: AuditService, useValue: audit },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(AuthService);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  const baseUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'admin@comtech.vn',
    passwordHash: 'hashed',
    isActive: true,
    isLocked: false,
    lockedAt: null,
    lockedReason: null,
    failedAttempts: 0,
    deletedAt: null,
    userRoles: [{ role: { name: 'admin' } }],
    employee: null,
  };

  describe('login', () => {
    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the user does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(service.login('nobody@x.com', 'pw', meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
      expect(audit.log).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ action: 'login_failed' }),
      );
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the account is soft-deleted', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        deletedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await expect(service.login(baseUser.email, 'pw', meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException and logs when the account is locked and lock has not expired', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        isLocked: true,
        lockedAt: new Date(),
        lockedReason: 'Khóa tự động do nhập sai mật khẩu 5 lần',
      });

      await expect(service.login(baseUser.email, 'pw', meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
      expect(prisma.user.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('auto-unlocks the account when the lock duration has elapsed', async () => {
      const longAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000); // 1 hour ago > 15 min lock
      // Lần gọi đầu (trong login()) thấy tài khoản đang khóa → kích hoạt tự
      // mở khóa; lần gọi sau (bên trong buildAuthUser()) mô phỏng DB đã được
      // cập nhật (isLocked: false), giống hành vi thật.
      prisma.user.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({
          ...baseUser,
          isLocked: true,
          lockedAt: longAgo,
          lockedReason: 'Khóa tự động do nhập sai mật khẩu 5 lần',
        })
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...baseUser, isLocked: false });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);

      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ isLocked: false }),
        }),
      );
      expect(result.accessToken).toBe('signed.jwt.token');
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the account is inactive', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        isActive: false,
      });

      await expect(service.login(baseUser.email, 'pw', meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
    });

    it('increments failedAttempts on wrong password without locking below the threshold', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        failedAttempts: 1,
      });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(false);

      await expect(
        service.login(baseUser.email, 'wrong', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);

      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ failedAttempts: 2 }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('locks the account once max failed attempts is reached', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        failedAttempts: 4,
      });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(false);

      await expect(
        service.login(baseUser.email, 'wrong', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);

      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            failedAttempts: 5,
            isLocked: true,
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('returns tokens and resets failedAttempts on successful login', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        failedAttempts: 2,
      });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);

      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ failedAttempts: 0 }),
        }),
      );
      expect(result.accessToken).toBe('signed.jwt.token');
      expect(result.refreshToken).toContain('user-1.');
      expect(result.user.roles).toEqual(['admin']);
      expect(audit.log).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ action: 'login' }),
      );
    });

    it('derives permissions from assigned roles via ROLE_PERMISSIONS', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(baseUser);
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);

      expect(Array.isArray(result.user.permissions)).toBe(true);
      expect(result.user.permissions.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('assigns no permissions for a role that has no entry in ROLE_PERMISSIONS', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        userRoles: [{ role: { name: 'unknown_role_xyz' } }],
      });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);

      expect(result.user.roles).toEqual(['unknown_role_xyz']);
      expect(result.user.permissions).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('records a null lastLoginIp when the request meta has no ip', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(baseUser);
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', {
        ip: null,
        userAgent: 'jest',
      });

      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ lastLoginIp: null }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the user record disappears between the credential check and building the auth payload', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(baseUser) // initial lookup in login()
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // buildAuthUser's own lookup fails
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);

      await expect(
        service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('includes the linked employee profile when the user account has one', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        employee: {
          id: 'emp-1',
          code: 'NV-0001',
          fullName: 'Nguyen Van A',
          avatarUrl: 'avatar.png',
          jobTitle: 'Developer',
          departmentId: 'dept-1',
          status: 'active',
          department: { id: 'dept-1' },
        },
      });
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);

      expect(result.user.employee).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ id: 'emp-1', code: 'NV-0001' }),
      );
      expect(result.user.fullName).toBe('Nguyen Van A');
    });
  });

  describe('parseAccessTtlSeconds (via login expiresIn)', () => {
    const originalEnv = process.env.JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN;

    afterEach(() => {
      if (originalEnv === undefined) {
        delete process.env.JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN;
      } else {
        process.env.JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN = originalEnv;
      }
    });

    const loginWithExpiry = async (expiresIn: string | undefined) => {
      if (expiresIn === undefined) {
        delete process.env.JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN;
      } else {
        process.env.JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN = expiresIn;
      }
      const freshService = new AuthService(
        prisma as any,
        jwt as any,
        audit as any,
      );
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(baseUser);
      (bcrypt.compare as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});
      return freshService.login(baseUser.email, 'correct-pw', meta);
    };

    it('parses seconds units (e.g. "30s")', async () => {
      const result = await loginWithExpiry('30s');
      expect(result.expiresIn).toBe(30);
    });

    it('parses hour units (e.g. "2h")', async () => {
      const result = await loginWithExpiry('2h');
      expect(result.expiresIn).toBe(7200);
    });

    it('parses day units (e.g. "1d")', async () => {
      const result = await loginWithExpiry('1d');
      expect(result.expiresIn).toBe(86400);
    });

    it('falls back to 900 seconds for an unparseable format', async () => {
      const result = await loginWithExpiry('not-a-duration');
      expect(result.expiresIn).toBe(900);
    });
  });

  describe('refresh', () => {
    it('throws UnauthorizedException when no token is provided', async () => {
      await expect(service.refresh(undefined, meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException for a malformed token missing the separator', async () => {
      await expect(service.refresh('malformed-token', meta)).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the stored token is not found', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the token is revoked', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
      });

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('throws UnauthorizedException when the token is expired', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000),
      });

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token on success', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
      });
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(baseUser);
      prisma.refreshToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta);

      expect(prisma.refreshToken.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }),
        }),
      );
      expect(result.accessToken).toBe('signed.jwt.token');
    });

    it('rejects refreshing a token for an account disabled after the token was issued', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
      });
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        isActive: false,
      });

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(prisma.refreshToken.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('rejects refreshing a token for an account locked after the token was issued', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
      });
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ ...baseUser, isLocked: true });

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(prisma.refreshToken.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('rejects refreshing a token for a soft-deleted account', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        revokedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
      });
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...baseUser,
        deletedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await expect(
        service.refresh('user-1.someRawToken', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(prisma.refreshToken.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('resetPassword', () => {
    it('throws BadRequestException for an invalid or unknown token', async () => {
      prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(
        service.resetPassword('bad-token', 'newpass', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException for an already used token', async () => {
      prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'r1',
        userId: 'user-1',
        usedAt: new Date(),
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
        user: baseUser,
      });

      await expect(
        service.resetPassword('used-token', 'newpass', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException for an expired token', async () => {
      prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'r1',
        userId: 'user-1',
        usedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000),
        user: baseUser,
      });

      await expect(
        service.resetPassword('expired-token', 'newpass', meta),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('updates the password and revokes existing sessions on success', async () => {
      prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'r1',
        userId: 'user-1',
        usedAt: null,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 100000),
        user: baseUser,
      });
      (bcrypt.hash as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue('new-hashed');
      prisma.$transaction.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.resetPassword(
        'valid-token',
        'newpass',
        meta,
      );

      expect(prisma.$transaction).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.message).toContain('thành công');
    });
  });

  describe('forgotPassword', () => {
    it('returns a generic message even when the email does not exist (no user enumeration)', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      const result = await service.forgotPassword('unknown@x.com', meta);

      expect(result.message).toContain('Nếu email tồn tại');
      expect(prisma.passwordResetToken.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('creates a reset token when the email exists', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(baseUser);
      prisma.passwordResetToken.create.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.forgotPassword(baseUser.email, meta);

      expect(prisma.passwordResetToken.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.message).toContain('Nếu email tồn tại');
    });
  });

  describe('logout', () => {
    it('revokes the refresh token and logs the logout action', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.logout(
        'user-1',
        baseUser.email,
        'user-1.someRawToken',
        meta,
      );

      expect(prisma.refreshToken.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(audit.log).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

      );
      expect(result.message).toContain('thành công');
    });

    it('does not fail when no refresh token is provided', async () => {
      const result = await service.logout(
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        meta,
      );
      expect(prisma.refreshToken.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.message).toContain('thành công');
    });

    it('swallows errors from revoking the refresh token and still completes logout', async () => {
      prisma.refreshToken.updateMany.mockRejectedValue(new Error('db down'));

      const result = await service.logout(

        baseUser.email,
        'user-1.someRawToken',
        meta,
      );

      expect(audit.log).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

      expect(result.message).toContain('thành công');

  });
```
