```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { DashboardService } from './dashboard.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

type MockPrisma = {
  customer: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  deal: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  task: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  department: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
};

describe('DashboardService', () => {
  let service: DashboardService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      customer: { count: jest.fn() },
      deal: { count: jest.fn(), aggregate: jest.fn(), groupBy: jest.fn() },
      task: { count: jest.fn(), groupBy: jest.fn() },
      employee: { count: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      department: { count: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        DashboardService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(DashboardService);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('summary', () => {
    it('returns aggregated stats with no filters', async () => {
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(10);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(3);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: 1000 },
        _count: { _all: 2 },
      });
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(1);
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(5);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(2);

      const result = await service.summary({});

      expect(result).toEqual({
        totalCustomers: 10,
        totalOpenDeals: 3,
        totalRevenue: 1000,
        wonDealsCount: 2,
        overdueTasks: 1,
        totalEmployees: 5,
        totalDepartments: 2,
        month: null,
      });
    });

    it('falls back to 0 revenue when no deals were won', async () => {
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: null },
        _count: { _all: 0 },
      });
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      const result = await service.summary({});
      expect(result.totalRevenue).toBe(0);
    });

    it('scopes by employeeId and month range', async () => {
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(1);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(1);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: 500 },
        _count: { _all: 1 },
      });
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(1);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.summary({
        month: '2026-09',
        employeeId: 'emp-1',
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.customer.count).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { deletedAt: null, assignedToId: 'emp-1' },
      });
      expect(prisma.employee.count).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { archivedAt: null, id: 'emp-1' },
      });
      expect(result.month).toBe('2026-09');
    });

    it('scopes by departmentId only (no employeeId)', async () => {
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(2);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(2);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: 200 },
        _count: { _all: 1 },
      });
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(2);
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(4);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      await service.summary({ departmentId: 'dept-1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.customer.count).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { deletedAt: null, assignedTo: { departmentId: 'dept-1' } },
      });
      expect(prisma.employee.count).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { archivedAt: null, departmentId: 'dept-1' },
      });
    });
  });

  describe('pipeline', () => {
    it('returns all stages with zero defaults when nothing matches', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.pipeline({});

      expect(result).toHaveLength(6);
      expect(result.every((s) => s.count === 0 && s.value === 0)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('fills in counts/values for stages present in the grouped result', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { stage: 'proposal', _count: { _all: 4 }, _sum: { value: 800 } },
        { stage: 'closed_won', _count: { _all: 2 }, _sum: { value: null } },
      ]);

      const result = await service.pipeline({
        month: '2026-09',
        employeeId: 'emp-1',
      } as any);

      const proposal = result.find((s) => s.stage === 'proposal');
      const closedWon = result.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_won');
      expect(proposal).toEqual({ stage: 'proposal', count: 4, value: 800 });
      expect(closedWon).toEqual({ stage: 'closed_won', count: 2, value: 0 });
    });
  });

  describe('departmentDistribution', () => {
    it('returns only departments with at least one employee', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: '1', code: 'KT', name: 'Kỹ thuật', employees: [{ id: 'e1' }] },
        { id: '2', code: 'HR', name: 'Nhân sự', employees: [] },
      ]);

      const result = await service.departmentDistribution();

      expect(result).toEqual([
        { id: '1', code: 'KT', name: 'Kỹ thuật', employeeCount: 1 },
      ]);
    });
  });

  describe('performance', () => {
    it('returns an empty array when no employees match the filter', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.performance({});

      expect(result).toEqual([]);
      expect(prisma.deal.groupBy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('ranks employees by revenue by default', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: 'e1', code: 'NV1', fullName: 'A', avatarUrl: null },
        { id: 'e2', code: 'NV2', fullName: 'B', avatarUrl: null },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _sum: { value: 100 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
        { assignedToId: 'e2', _sum: { value: 500 }, _count: { _all: 2 } },
      ]);
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _count: { _all: 3 } },
      ]);

      const result = await service.performance({});

      expect(result[0].id).toBe('e2');
      expect(result[0].revenue).toBe(500);
      expect(result[1].tasksCompleted).toBe(3);
    });

    it('ranks employees by tasksCompleted when sortBy is set, and filters by employeeId/departmentId/month', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: 'e1', code: 'NV1', fullName: 'A', avatarUrl: null },
        { id: 'e2', code: 'NV2', fullName: 'B', avatarUrl: null },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _count: { _all: 9 } },
        { assignedToId: 'e2', _count: { _all: 2 } },
      ]);

      const result = await service.performance({
        sortBy: 'tasksCompleted',
        employeeId: 'e1',
        departmentId: 'dept-1',
        month: '2026-09',
        limit: 5,
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.employee.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { archivedAt: null, id: 'e1', departmentId: 'dept-1' },
        select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true, avatarUrl: true },
      });
      expect(result).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(result[0].id).toBe('e1');
      expect(result[0].tasksCompleted).toBe(9);
      expect(result[0].dealsWonCount).toBe(0);
      expect(result[0].revenue).toBe(0);
      expect(result[1].id).toBe('e2');
    });

    it('respects the limit and default sortBy/limit fallbacks', async () => {
      const employees = Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => ({
        id: `e${i}`,
        code: `NV${i}`,
        fullName: `Emp ${i}`,
        avatarUrl: null,
      }));
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue(employees);
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e0', _sum: { value: 10 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _sum: { value: 30 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
        { assignedToId: 'e2', _sum: { value: 20 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
      ]);
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.performance({ limit: 2 } as any);

      expect(result).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(result[0].id).toBe('e1');
      expect(result[1].id).toBe('e2');
    });
  });

  describe('birthdays', () => {
    const makeDate = (month: number, day: number) =>
      new Date(Date.UTC(1990, month - 1, day));

    it('splits employees into today and tomorrow based on UTC month/day', async () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const todayMonth = now.getUTCMonth() + 1;
      const todayDay = now.getUTCDate();
      const tomorrow = new Date(now);
      tomorrow.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);

      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: 'e1',
          code: 'NV1',
          fullName: 'Sinh nhật hôm nay',
          avatarUrl: null,
          dateOfBirth: makeDate(todayMonth, todayDay),
          department: { id: 'd1', name: 'Kỹ thuật' },
        },
        {
          id: 'e2',
          code: 'NV2',
          fullName: 'Sinh nhật ngày mai',
          avatarUrl: null,
          dateOfBirth: makeDate(
            tomorrow.getUTCMonth() + 1,
            tomorrow.getUTCDate(),
          ),
          department: { id: 'd1', name: 'Kỹ thuật' },
        },
        {
          id: 'e3',
          code: 'NV3',
          fullName: 'Không trùng',
          avatarUrl: null,
          // Chọn một mốc cách xa hôm nay/ngày mai tối thiểu vài ngày để tránh trùng lịch.
          dateOfBirth: (() => {
            const far = new Date(now);
            far.setUTCDate(far.getUTCDate() + 10);
            return far;
          })(),
          department: { id: 'd1', name: 'Kỹ thuật' },
        },
      ]);

      const result = await service.birthdays();

      expect(result.today.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['e1']);
      expect(result.tomorrow.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['e2']);
    });

    it('queries only employees with a non-null dateOfBirth', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      await service.birthdays();
      expect(prisma.employee.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { archivedAt: null, dateOfBirth: { not: null } },
        }),
      );
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/dashboard/dashboard.service.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import {
  QueryDashboardDto,
  QueryPerformanceDto,
} from './dto/query-dashboard.dto';

/** Khoảng thời gian nửa mở [gte, lt) tương ứng với một tháng dương lịch */
interface MonthRange {
  gte: Date;
  lt: Date;
}

@Injectable()
export class DashboardService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** "2026-09" → { gte: 2026-09-01, lt: 2026-10-01 } (giờ UTC) */
  private parseMonthRange(month?: string): MonthRange | undefined {
    if (!month) return undefined;
    const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');
    const year = Number(yearStr);
    const monthIndex = Number(monthStr) - 1; // 0-based
    const gte = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex, 1));
    const lt = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex + 1, 1));
    return { gte, lt };
  }

  /** Điều kiện lọc theo nhân viên phụ trách: employeeId cụ thể, hoặc mọi nhân viên
   * thuộc departmentId, hoặc không lọc nếu cả hai đều trống. */
  private assigneeFilter(employeeId?: string, departmentId?: string) {
    if (employeeId) return { assignedToId: employeeId };
    if (departmentId) return { assignedTo: { departmentId } };
    return {};
  }

  async summary(query: QueryDashboardDto) {
    const range = this.parseMonthRange(query.month);
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);

    const [
      totalCustomers,
      totalOpenDeals,
      wonAgg,
      overdueTasks,
      totalEmployees,
      totalDepartments,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.customer.count({
        where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
      }),
      this.prisma.deal.count({
        where: { deletedAt: null, status: 'open', ...assignee },
      }),
      this.prisma.deal.aggregate({
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          stage: 'closed_won',
          ...assignee,
          ...(range ? { closedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt } } : {}),
        },
        _sum: { value: true },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.task.count({
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          status: { notIn: ['done'] },
          dueDate: { lt: new Date() },
          ...assignee,
        },
      }),
      this.prisma.employee.count({
        where: {
          archivedAt: null,
          ...(query.employeeId
            ? { id: query.employeeId }
            : query.departmentId
              ? { departmentId: query.departmentId }
              : {}),
        },
      }),
      this.prisma.department.count({ where: { deletedAt: null } }),
    ]);

    return {
      totalCustomers,
      totalOpenDeals,
      totalRevenue: wonAgg._sum.value ? Number(wonAgg._sum.value) : 0,
      wonDealsCount: wonAgg._count._all,
      overdueTasks,
      totalEmployees,
      totalDepartments,
      month: query.month ?? null,
    };
  }

  /** Số lượng & tổng giá trị cơ hội theo từng giai đoạn (biểu đồ cột Pipeline) */
  async pipeline(query: QueryDashboardDto) {
    const range = this.parseMonthRange(query.month);
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);

    const ALL_STAGES = [
      'prospecting',
      'qualification',
      'proposal',
      'negotiation',
      'closed_won',
      'closed_lost',
    ];

    const grouped = await this.prisma.deal.groupBy({
      by: ['stage'],
      where: {
        deletedAt: null,
        ...assignee,
        ...(range ? { createdAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt } } : {}),
      },
      _count: { _all: true },
      _sum: { value: true },
    });

    return ALL_STAGES.map((stage) => {
      const g = grouped.find((x) => x.stage === stage);
      return {
        stage,
        count: g?._count._all ?? 0,
        value: g?._sum.value ? Number(g._sum.value) : 0,
      };
    });
  }

  /** Phân bổ nhân viên theo phòng ban (biểu đồ tròn) */
  async departmentDistribution() {
    const departments = await this.prisma.department.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        employees: { where: { archivedAt: null }, select: { id: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    return departments
      .map((d) => ({
        id: d.id,
        code: d.code,
        name: d.name,
        employeeCount: d.employees.length,
      }))
      .filter((d) => d.employeeCount > 0);
  }

  /** Top nhân viên theo doanh số cơ hội thắng hoặc số công việc hoàn thành (biểu đồ cột Hiệu suất) */
  async performance(query: QueryPerformanceDto) {
    const range = this.parseMonthRange(query.month);
    const limit = query.limit ?? 5;
    const sortBy = query.sortBy ?? 'revenue';

    const employeeWhere: any = { archivedAt: null };
    if (query.employeeId) employeeWhere.id = query.employeeId;
    if (query.departmentId) employeeWhere.departmentId = query.departmentId;

    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: employeeWhere,
      select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true, avatarUrl: true },
    });
    const employeeIds = employees.map((e) => e.id);
    if (employeeIds.length === 0) return [];

    const [dealsWon, tasksCompleted] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.deal.groupBy({
        by: ['assignedToId'],
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          stage: 'closed_won',
          assignedToId: { in: employeeIds },
          ...(range ? { closedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt } } : {}),
        },
        _sum: { value: true },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.task.groupBy({
        by: ['assignedToId'],
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          status: 'done',
          assignedToId: { in: employeeIds },
          ...(range ? { completedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt } } : {}),
        },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
    ]);

    const results = employees.map((e) => {
      const deal = dealsWon.find((d) => d.assignedToId === e.id);
      const task = tasksCompleted.find((t) => t.assignedToId === e.id);
      return {
        id: e.id,
        code: e.code,
        fullName: e.fullName,
        avatarUrl: e.avatarUrl,
        dealsWonCount: deal?._count._all ?? 0,
        revenue: deal?._sum.value ? Number(deal._sum.value) : 0,
        tasksCompleted: task?._count._all ?? 0,
      };
    });

    results.sort((a, b) =>
      sortBy === 'tasksCompleted'
        ? b.tasksCompleted - a.tasksCompleted
        : b.revenue - a.revenue,
    );

    return results.slice(0, limit);
  }

  /** Sinh nhật nhân viên hôm nay và ngày mai (so khớp theo ngày/tháng, bỏ qua năm) */
  async birthdays() {
    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: { archivedAt: null, dateOfBirth: { not: null } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        code: true,
        fullName: true,
        avatarUrl: true,
        dateOfBirth: true,
        department: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      },
    });

    const now = new Date();
    const tomorrow = new Date(now);
    tomorrow.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);

    const matches = (d: Date, ref: Date) =>
      d.getUTCMonth() === ref.getUTCMonth() &&
      d.getUTCDate() === ref.getUTCDate();

    const today = employees.filter((e) => matches(e.dateOfBirth!, now));
    const tomorrowList = employees.filter((e) =>
      matches(e.dateOfBirth!, tomorrow),
    );

    return { today, tomorrow: tomorrowList };
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/dashboard/dto/query-dashboard.dto.ts`

```typescript
import {
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsOptional,
  IsUUID,
  Matches,
  Max,
  Min,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';

/**
 * Bộ lọc dùng chung cho toàn bộ endpoint Dashboard.
 * - month: giới hạn dữ liệu theo tháng (cơ hội đóng, công việc tạo) — định dạng YYYY-MM.
 *   Bỏ trống = toàn bộ thời gian.
 * - departmentId / employeeId: thu hẹp phạm vi theo phòng ban hoặc một nhân viên cụ thể.
 *   Áp dụng cho các số liệu gắn với nhân viên (cơ hội, khách hàng, công việc phụ trách).
 */
export class QueryDashboardDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @Matches(/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/, {
    message: 'month phải theo định dạng YYYY-MM',
  })
  month?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID()
  departmentId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID()
  employeeId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 5))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(20)
  limit?: number = 5;
}

export class QueryPerformanceDto extends QueryDashboardDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['revenue', 'tasksCompleted'])
  sortBy?: 'revenue' | 'tasksCompleted' = 'revenue';
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { DealsController } from './deals.controller';
import { DealsService } from './deals.service';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

describe('DealsController', () => {
  let controller: DealsController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;

  const user: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'u1',
    email: 'a@b.com',
    roles: ['employee'],
    permissions: ['opportunities:create:all'],
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      pipeline: jest.fn(),
      stats: jest.fn(),
      assignees: jest.fn(),
      customers: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      activities: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn(),
      addActivity: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn(),
      moveStage: jest.fn(),
      remove: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [DealsController],

    }).compile();

    controller = module.get(DealsController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  it('delegates findAll() to the service with the current user', async () => {

    expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, query);
    expect(result).toEqual({ data: [], total: 0 });
  });

  it('delegates pipeline() to the service with the current user', async () => {

    service.pipeline.mockResolvedValue([{ stage: 'prospecting', count: 0 }]);

    const result = await controller.pipeline(query, user);

    expect(service.pipeline).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, query);
    expect(result).toEqual([{ stage: 'prospecting', count: 0 }]);
  });

  it('delegates stats() to the service', async () => {
    service.stats.mockResolvedValue({ funnel: [], forecast: {} });
    const result = await controller.stats();
    expect(service.stats).toHaveBeenCalledWith();
    expect(result).toEqual({ funnel: [], forecast: {} });
  });

  it('delegates assignees() to the service', async () => {
    service.assignees.mockResolvedValue([]);
    const result = await controller.assignees();
    expect(service.assignees).toHaveBeenCalledWith();
    expect(result).toEqual([]);
  });

  describe('customers', () => {
    it('passes through an undefined search term', async () => {
      service.customers.mockResolvedValue([]);
      const result = await controller.customers(undefined);
      expect(service.customers).toHaveBeenCalledWith(undefined);
      expect(result).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('passes through a search term', async () => {
      service.customers.mockResolvedValue([{ id: 'c1' }]);
      const result = await controller.customers('ABC');
      expect(service.customers).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ABC');
      expect(result).toEqual([{ id: 'c1' }]);
    });
  });

  it('delegates findOne() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    service.findOne.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'd1' });
    const result = await controller.findOne('d1', user);
    expect(service.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, 'd1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'd1' });
  });

  it('delegates activities() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    service.activities.mockResolvedValue([{ id: 'act1' }]);
    const result = await controller.activities('d1', user);
    expect(service.activities).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, 'd1');
    expect(result).toEqual([{ id: 'act1' }]);
  });

  it('delegates create() to the service with the current user id', async () => {
    const dto = { name: 'Deal 1', customerId: 'c1' } as any;
    service.create.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'd1' });

    const result = await controller.create(dto, user);

    expect(service.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto, 'u1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'd1' });
  });

  it('delegates addActivity() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    const dto = { type: 'note', content: 'Gọi điện' } as any;
    service.addActivity.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'd1' });

    const result = await controller.addActivity('d1', dto, user);

    expect(service.addActivity).toHaveBeenCalledWith('d1', dto, user);
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'd1' });
  });

  it('delegates update() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    const dto = { name: 'Deal 1 updated' } as any;
    service.update.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'd1' });

    const result = await controller.update('d1', dto, user);

    expect(service.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith('d1', dto, user);
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'd1' });
  });

  it('delegates moveStage() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    const dto = { stage: 'closed_won' } as any;
    service.moveStage.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'd1', stage: 'closed_won' });

    const result = await controller.moveStage('d1', dto, user);

    expect(service.moveStage).toHaveBeenCalledWith('d1', dto, user);
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'd1', stage: 'closed_won' });
  });

  it('delegates remove() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    service.remove.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });
    const result = await controller.remove('d1', user);
    expect(service.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, 'd1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ success: true });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/deals/deals.controller.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { DealsService } from './deals.service';
import { CreateDealDto } from './dto/create-deal.dto';
import { UpdateDealDto } from './dto/update-deal.dto';
import { QueryDealDto } from './dto/query-deal.dto';
import { MoveStageDto } from './dto/move-stage.dto';
import { CreateActivityDto } from './dto/create-activity.dto';
import { RequirePermissions } from '../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  RequestUser,
} from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

@ApiTags('deals')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('deals')
export class DealsController {
  constructor(private readonly dealsService: DealsService) {}

  // GET /api/deals — danh sách (phân trang, tìm kiếm, lọc)
  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  findAll(@Query() query: QueryDealDto, @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.dealsService.findAll(user, query);
  }

  // GET /api/deals/pipeline — dữ liệu Kanban theo giai đoạn
  @Get('pipeline')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  pipeline(@Query() query: QueryDealDto, @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.dealsService.pipeline(user, query);
  }

  // GET /api/deals/stats — thống kê (funnel, dự báo doanh thu)
  @Get('stats')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  stats() {
    return this.dealsService.stats();
  }

  // GET /api/deals/assignees — danh sách nhân viên để phân công
  @Get('assignees')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  assignees() {
    return this.dealsService.assignees();
  }

  // GET /api/deals/customers — danh sách khách hàng gọn cho dropdown
  @Get('customers')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  customers(@Query('search') search?: string) {
    return this.dealsService.customers(search);
  }

  // GET /api/deals/:id — chi tiết (kèm lịch sử hoạt động)
  @Get(':id')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  findOne(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.findOne(user, id);
  }

  // GET /api/deals/:id/activities — lịch sử hoạt động
  @Get(':id/activities')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:read')
  activities(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.activities(user, id);
  }

  // POST /api/deals — tạo mới
  @Post()
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:create')
  create(@Body() dto: CreateDealDto, @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.dealsService.create(dto, user.userId);
  }

  // POST /api/deals/:id/activities — thêm hoạt động / ghi chú
  @Post(':id/activities')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:update')
  addActivity(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: CreateActivityDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.addActivity(id, dto, user);
  }

  // PATCH /api/deals/:id — cập nhật
  @Patch(':id')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:update')
  update(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdateDealDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.update(id, dto, user);
  }

  // PATCH /api/deals/:id/stage — chuyển giai đoạn (kéo thả Kanban)
  @Patch(':id/stage')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:update')
  moveStage(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: MoveStageDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.moveStage(id, dto, user);
  }

  // DELETE /api/deals/:id — xoá mềm
  @Delete(':id')
  @RequirePermissions('opportunities:delete')
  remove(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.dealsService.remove(user, id);
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/deals/deals.service.spec.ts`

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { BadRequestException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DealsService } from './deals.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

type MockPrisma = {
  deal: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  dealActivity: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  customer: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  $transaction: jest.Mock;
};

describe('DealsService', () => {
  let service: DealsService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  // Người dùng có scope "all" (vd: admin) — không bị thu hẹp truy vấn.
  const allUser: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'u-admin',
    email: 'admin@b.com',
    roles: ['admin'],
    permissions: [
      'opportunities:read:all',
      'opportunities:update:all',
      'opportunities:delete:all',
    ],
  };
  // Người dùng có scope "department" (vd: manager).
  const deptUser: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'u-manager',
    email: 'manager@b.com',
    roles: ['manager'],
    permissions: ['opportunities:read:department', 'opportunities:update:department'],
  };
  // Người dùng có scope "own" (vd: nhân viên kinh doanh).
  const ownUser: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'u-sales',
    email: 'sales@b.com',
    roles: ['employee'],
    permissions: ['opportunities:read:own', 'opportunities:update:own'],
  };

  const dealRow = (overrides: Partial<any> = {}) => ({
    id: 'd1',
    code: 'CH-0001',
    name: 'Triển khai CRM',
    customerId: 'c1',
    customer: {
      id: 'c1',
      code: 'KH-0001',
      name: 'Công ty ABC',
      type: 'company',
    },
    value: 100_000_000,
    currency: 'VND',
    probability: 50,
    stage: 'proposal',
    status: 'open',
    source: 'website',
    expectedCloseDate: null,
    closedAt: null,
    lostReason: null,
    description: null,
    assignedToId: 'emp1',
    assignedTo: {
      id: 'emp1',
      code: 'NV-0001',
      fullName: 'Nhân viên A',
      avatarUrl: null,
      jobTitle: 'Sales',
      departmentId: 'dept1',
    },
    createdById: 'u1',
    createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01'),
    activities: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  });

  const activityRow = (overrides: Partial<any> = {}) => ({
    id: 'a1',
    dealId: 'd1',
    type: 'created',
    content: 'Đã tạo cơ hội bán hàng',
    fromStage: null,
    toStage: 'prospecting',
    createdById: 'u1',
    createdBy: { email: 'u1@b.com', employee: { fullName: 'Người tạo' } },
    createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01'),
    ...overrides,
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      deal: {
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
        create: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
        groupBy: jest.fn(),
      },
      dealActivity: { create: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      customer: { findFirst: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      employee: {
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
      },
      $transaction: jest.fn((ops: Promise<any>[]) => Promise.all(ops)),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [DealsService, { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma }],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(DealsService);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // findAll / buildWhere
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('applies default pagination and maps results, including value coercion', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([dealRow()]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.findAll(allUser, {} as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          skip: 0,
          take: 20,
          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        }),
      );
      expect(result.data[0]).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ id: 'd1', value: 100_000_000 }),
      );
    });

    it('maps a deal with no customer/assignee to null, and a null value to 0', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        dealRow({ customer: null, assignedTo: null, value: null }),
      ]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.findAll(allUser, {} as any);
      expect(result.data[0].customer).toBeNull();
      expect(result.data[0].assignedTo).toBeNull();
      expect(result.data[0].value).toBe(0);
    });

    it('clamps pageSize to 1-100 and page to a minimum of 1', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { page: -3, pageSize: 999 } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ skip: 0, take: 100 }),
      );
    });

    it('filters by stage/status/assignedToId/customerId', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, {
        stage: 'proposal',
        status: 'open',
        assignedToId: 'emp1',
        customerId: 'c1',
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({
            stage: 'proposal',
            status: 'open',
            assignedToId: 'emp1',
            customerId: 'c1',
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies a min/max value range filter when both are valid numbers', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { minValue: '10', maxValue: '100' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({ value: { gte: 10, lte: 100 } }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies only minValue when maxValue is absent', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { minValue: '10' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({ value: { gte: 10 } }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('ignores a non-numeric minValue/maxValue instead of filtering', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { minValue: 'abc', maxValue: 'xyz' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.not.objectContaining({ value: expect.anything() }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('builds a search clause across deal and customer fields, trimmed', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { search: '  abc  ' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({
            OR: expect.arrayContaining([
              { name: { contains: 'abc', mode: 'insensitive' } },
            ]),
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('ignores a blank search term', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { search: '   ' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.not.objectContaining({ OR: expect.anything() }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('honors a custom sortBy/sortOrder', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, { sortBy: 'value', sortOrder: 'asc' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ orderBy: { value: 'asc' } }),
      );
    });

    it('defaults totalPages to 1 when there are no results', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      const result = await service.findAll(allUser, {} as any);
      expect(result.totalPages).toBe(1);
    });

    // --- Phân quyền theo phạm vi (bảo mật) ---

    it('scope "all": không thu hẹp where, không cần tra hồ sơ nhân viên', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(allUser, {} as any);

      expect(prisma.employee.findFirst).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('scope "own": chỉ thấy cơ hội được phân công cho chính mình', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-sales',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(ownUser, {} as any);

      expect(prisma.employee.findFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { userId: 'u-sales', archivedAt: null },
      });
      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({ assignedToId: 'emp-sales' }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('scope "department": chỉ thấy cơ hội của nhân viên cùng phòng ban', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-manager',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll(deptUser, {} as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({
            assignedTo: { departmentId: 'dept1' },
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('scope "own"/"department" báo lỗi nếu tài khoản chưa liên kết hồ sơ nhân viên', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.findAll(ownUser, {} as any)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });
  });

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // pipeline
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('pipeline', () => {
    it('groups open+closed deals into one Kanban column per stage, ignoring any stage filter in the query', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        dealRow({ id: 'd1', stage: 'prospecting', value: 100 }),
        dealRow({ id: 'd2', stage: 'prospecting', value: 200 }),
        dealRow({ id: 'd3', stage: 'closed_won', value: 300 }),
      ]);

      const columns = await service.pipeline(allUser, {
        stage: 'proposal',
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.not.objectContaining({ stage: expect.anything() }),
        }),
      );
      const prospecting = columns.find((c) => c.stage === 'prospecting')!;
      expect(prospecting.count).toBe(2);
      expect(prospecting.value).toBe(300);
      const won = columns.find((c) => c.stage === 'closed_won')!;
      expect(won.count).toBe(1);
      expect(won.value).toBe(300);
      const negotiation = columns.find((c) => c.stage === 'negotiation')!;
      expect(negotiation.count).toBe(0);
      expect(negotiation.value).toBe(0);
    });

    it('scope "own": chỉ nhóm các cơ hội được phân công cho chính mình', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-sales',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      await service.pipeline(ownUser, {} as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({ assignedToId: 'emp-sales' }),
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // findOne
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('findOne', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when the deal does not exist or is soft-deleted', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.findOne(allUser, 'nx')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('returns the mapped deal with its activities, including the createdByName fallback chain', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({
          activities: [
            activityRow({
              createdBy: {
                email: 'e@b.com',
                employee: { fullName: 'Tên đầy đủ' },
              },
            }),
            activityRow({
              id: 'a2',
              createdBy: { email: 'onlyemail@b.com', employee: null },
            }),
            activityRow({ id: 'a3', createdBy: null }),
          ],
        }),
      );

      const result = await service.findOne(allUser, 'd1');

      expect(result.activities?.[0].createdByName).toBe('Tên đầy đủ');
      expect(result.activities?.[1].createdByName).toBe('onlyemail@b.com');
      expect(result.activities?.[2].createdByName).toBeNull();
    });

    // --- Phân quyền theo phạm vi (bảo mật) ---

    it('scope "own": xem được cơ hội được phân công cho chính mình', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({ assignedToId: 'emp-sales' }),
      );
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-sales',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });

      const result = await service.findOne(ownUser, 'd1');
      expect(result.id).toBe('d1');
    });

    it('scope "own": báo "không tìm thấy" khi cơ hội được phân công cho người khác', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({ assignedToId: 'someone-else' }),
      );
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-sales',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });

      await expect(service.findOne(ownUser, 'd1')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('scope "department": báo "không tìm thấy" khi cơ hội thuộc phòng ban khác', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({
          assignedToId: 'emp-other',
          assignedTo: { id: 'emp-other', departmentId: 'dept2' },
        }),
      );
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-manager',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });

      await expect(service.findOne(deptUser, 'd1')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('scope "department": xem được cơ hội của đồng nghiệp cùng phòng ban', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({
          assignedToId: 'emp-colleague',
          assignedTo: { id: 'emp-colleague', departmentId: 'dept1' },
        }),
      );
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'emp-manager',
        departmentId: 'dept1',
      });

      const result = await service.findOne(deptUser, 'd1');
      expect(result.id).toBe('d1');
    });
  });

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // create
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('create', () => {
    const dto = { name: 'Cơ hội mới', customerId: 'c1' } as any;

    it('throws BadRequestException when the customer does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.create(dto)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when the assignee does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.create({ ...dto, assignedToId: 'ghost' }),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('defaults stage to prospecting, derives status and probability from the stage table, and generates the next code', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ code: 'CH-0003' });
      prisma.deal.create.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({ code: 'CH-0004', stage: 'prospecting', probability: 10 }),
      );

      const result = await service.create(dto, 'u1');

      expect(prisma.deal.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            code: 'CH-0004',
            stage: 'prospecting',
            status: 'open',
            probability: 10,
            closedAt: null,
            createdById: 'u1',
            activities: {
              create: expect.objectContaining({
                type: 'created',
                toStage: 'prospecting',
              }),
            },
          }),
        }),
      );
      expect(result.code).toBe('CH-0004');
    });

    it('starts numbering at CH-0001 when no deal exists yet', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      prisma.deal.create.mockResolvedValue(dealRow({ code: 'CH-0001' }));

      await service.create(dto);

      expect(prisma.deal.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ code: 'CH-0001' }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('respects an explicit probability over the stage default', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      prisma.deal.create.mockResolvedValue(dealRow());

      await service.create({ ...dto, probability: 33 });

      expect(prisma.deal.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ probability: 33 }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('marks a deal created directly as closed_won with closedAt set', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      prisma.deal.create.mockResolvedValue(
        dealRow({ stage: 'closed_won', status: 'won' }),
      );

      await service.create({ ...dto, stage: 'closed_won' });

      expect(prisma.deal.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            stage: 'closed_won',
            status: 'won',
            closedAt: expect.any(Date),
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('defaults value to 0 and parses expectedCloseDate when given', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'c1' });
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      prisma.deal.create.mockResolvedValue(dealRow());

      await service.create({ ...dto, expectedCloseDate: '2026-12-01' });

      expect(prisma.deal.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            value: 0,
            expectedCloseDate: new Date('2026-12-01'),
          }),
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // update
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('update', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when the deal does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.update('nx', {} as any, allUser),
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when reassigning to a non-existent customer', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(dealRow());
      prisma.customer.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.update('d1', { customerId: 'ghost' } as any, allUser),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when reassigning to a non-existent employee', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(dealRow());
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.update('d1', { assignedToId: 'ghost' } as any, allUser),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('writes only fields explicitly present in the dto, converting empty strings to null', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(dealRow());
      prisma.deal.update.mockResolvedValue(

        expect.objectContaining({ where: { deletedAt: null }, take: 200 }),

      prisma.customer.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      await service.customers('  abc  ');

    it('ignores a blank search term', async () => {

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  describe('stats', () => {

      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { stage: 'prospecting', _count: { _all: 2 }, _sum: { value: 500 } },
        { stage: 'closed_won', _count: { _all: 3 }, _sum: { value: 900 } },
        { stage: 'closed_lost', _count: { _all: 1 }, _sum: { value: 100 } },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { value: 100, probability: 50 },
        { value: 200, probability: 25 },
      ]);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result.totalOpen).toBe(2);
      expect(result.totalOpenValue).toBe(300);
      expect(result.weightedForecast).toBe(Math.round(100 * 0.5 + 200 * 0.25));
      expect(result.wonCount).toBe(3);
      expect(result.wonValue).toBe(900);
      expect(result.lostCount).toBe(1);
      expect(result.conversionRate).toBe(75); // 3 / (3+1) = 75%
      expect(result.byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'negotiation')).toEqual({
        stage: 'negotiation',
        count: 0,
        value: 0,
      });
    });

    it('returns conversionRate 0 and all-zero figures when there are no deals at all', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result.conversionRate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.totalOpen).toBe(0);
      expect(result.totalOpenValue).toBe(0);
      expect(result.weightedForecast).toBe(0);
    });

    it('treats a null aggregated value sum as 0', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { stage: 'prospecting', _count: { _all: 1 }, _sum: { value: null } },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { value: null, probability: 50 },
      ]);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result.byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'prospecting')?.value).toBe(
        0,
      );
      expect(result.totalOpenValue).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/deals/deals.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';

import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateDealDto } from './dto/create-deal.dto';
import { UpdateDealDto } from './dto/update-deal.dto';
import { QueryDealDto } from './dto/query-deal.dto';
import { MoveStageDto } from './dto/move-stage.dto';
import { CreateActivityDto } from './dto/create-activity.dto';
import { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { createWithSequentialCodeRetry } from '../common/utils/retry-on-conflict.util';

type Scope = 'all' | 'department' | 'own';

/** Danh sách stage đang mở (chưa đóng) theo thứ tự phễu bán hàng */
const OPEN_STAGES = ['prospecting', 'qualification', 'proposal', 'negotiation'];
const ALL_STAGES = [...OPEN_STAGES, 'closed_won', 'closed_lost'];

/** Xác suất mặc định gợi ý theo từng stage (%) */
const STAGE_PROBABILITY: Record<string, number> = {
  prospecting: 10,
  qualification: 25,
  proposal: 50,
  negotiation: 75,
  closed_won: 100,
  closed_lost: 0,
};

@Injectable()
export class DealsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  private statusFromStage(stage: string): 'open' | 'won' | 'lost' {
    if (stage === 'closed_won') return 'won';
    if (stage === 'closed_lost') return 'lost';
    return 'open';
  }

  private mapDeal(d: any) {
    return {
      id: d.id,
      code: d.code,
      name: d.name,
      customerId: d.customerId,
      customer: d.customer
        ? {
            id: d.customer.id,
            code: d.customer.code,
            name: d.customer.name,
            type: d.customer.type,
          }
        : null,
      value: d.value != null ? Number(d.value) : 0,
      currency: d.currency,
      probability: d.probability,
      stage: d.stage,
      status: d.status,
      source: d.source,
      expectedCloseDate: d.expectedCloseDate,
      closedAt: d.closedAt,
      lostReason: d.lostReason,
      description: d.description,
      assignedToId: d.assignedToId,
      assignedTo: d.assignedTo
        ? {
            id: d.assignedTo.id,
            code: d.assignedTo.code,
            fullName: d.assignedTo.fullName,
            avatarUrl: d.assignedTo.avatarUrl,
            jobTitle: d.assignedTo.jobTitle,
          }
        : null,
      createdById: d.createdById,
      createdAt: d.createdAt,
      updatedAt: d.updatedAt,
      activities: d.activities
        ? d.activities.map((a: any) => this.mapActivity(a))
        : undefined,
    };
  }

  private mapActivity(a: any) {
    return {
      id: a.id,
      dealId: a.dealId,
      type: a.type,
      content: a.content,
      fromStage: a.fromStage,
      toStage: a.toStage,
      createdById: a.createdById,
      createdByName:
        a.createdBy?.employee?.fullName ?? a.createdBy?.email ?? null,
      createdAt: a.createdAt,
    };
  }

  /** Sinh mã cơ hội tiếp theo dạng CH-0001 */
  private async nextDealCode(): Promise<string> {
    const last = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { code: { startsWith: 'CH-' } },
      orderBy: { code: 'desc' },
    });
    const n = last ? parseInt(last.code.replace('CH-', ''), 10) + 1 : 1;
    return `CH-${String(n).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  }

  private async validateCustomer(customerId: string) {
    const customer = await this.prisma.customer.findFirst({
      where: { id: customerId, deletedAt: null },
    });
    if (!customer) throw new BadRequestException('Khách hàng không tồn tại.');
    return customer;
  }

  private async validateAssignee(assignedToId?: string) {
    if (!assignedToId) return;
    const emp = await this.prisma.employee.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignedToId },
    });
    if (!emp) throw new BadRequestException('Người phụ trách không tồn tại.');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Phân quyền theo phạm vi (own/department/all)
  //
  // Quan trọng: PermissionsGuard (guard toàn cục) chỉ kiểm tra user CÓ quyền
  // "opportunities:<action>" hay không — nó KHÔNG phân biệt scope own/
  // department/all (xem common/guards/permissions.guard.ts). Ma trận quyền
  // (common/permissions.ts) lại cấp cho "employee" duy nhất
  // "opportunities:read:own"/"opportunities:update:own", và cho "manager"
  // duy nhất scope "department" — nếu service không tự thu hẹp truy vấn
  // theo scope, một nhân viên hoặc quản lý bình thường sẽ xem/sửa được MỌI
  // cơ hội bán hàng trong hệ thống. Các hàm dưới đây bù đắp phần đó.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  private resolveScope(user: RequestUser, action: string): Scope {
    const perms = user.permissions ?? [];
    if (perms.some((p) => p.startsWith(`opportunities:${action}:all`)))
      return 'all';
    if (perms.some((p) => p.startsWith(`opportunities:${action}:department`)))
      return 'department';
    return 'own';
  }

  private async resolveEmployee(userId: string) {
    const employee = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { userId, archivedAt: null },
    });
    if (!employee) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Tài khoản của bạn chưa được liên kết với hồ sơ nhân viên.',
      );
    }
    return employee;
  }

  /** Thu hẹp mệnh đề where theo scope — dùng cho danh sách/pipeline. */
  private async applyScope(where: any, user: RequestUser, action: string) {
    const scope = this.resolveScope(user, action);
    if (scope === 'all') return;
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    if (scope === 'own') {
      where.assignedToId = employee.id;
    } else {
      where.assignedTo = { departmentId: employee.departmentId };
    }
  }

  /** Kiểm tra 1 cơ hội cụ thể có nằm trong phạm vi cho phép không — dùng cho
   *  chi tiết/cập nhật/xoá. Ngoài phạm vi thì coi như "không tìm thấy" để
   *  không lộ sự tồn tại của bản ghi ngoài phạm vi truy cập. */
  private async assertInScope(
    user: RequestUser,
    action: string,
    record: {
      assignedToId: string | null;
      assignedTo?: { departmentId: string | null } | null;
    },
  ) {
    const scope = this.resolveScope(user, action);
    if (scope === 'all') return;
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    if (scope === 'own') {
      if (record.assignedToId !== employee.id) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
      }
      return;
    }
    const recordDept = record.assignedTo?.departmentId ?? null;
    if (recordDept === null || recordDept !== employee.departmentId) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    }
  }

  private buildWhere(query: QueryDealDto): any {
    const where: any = { deletedAt: null };
    if (query.stage) where.stage = query.stage;
    if (query.status) where.status = query.status;
    if (query.assignedToId) where.assignedToId = query.assignedToId;
    if (query.customerId) where.customerId = query.customerId;

    const min = query.minValue ? Number(query.minValue) : undefined;
    const max = query.maxValue ? Number(query.maxValue) : undefined;
    if (
      (min !== undefined && !Number.isNaN(min)) ||
      (max !== undefined && !Number.isNaN(max))
    ) {
      where.value = {};
      if (min !== undefined && !Number.isNaN(min)) where.value.gte = min;
      if (max !== undefined && !Number.isNaN(max)) where.value.lte = max;
    }

    if (query.search && query.search.trim()) {
      const term = query.search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { code: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { customer: { is: { name: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } } } },
        { customer: { is: { code: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } } } },
      ];
    }
    return where;
  }

  async findAll(user: RequestUser, query: QueryDealDto) {
    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 100);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where = this.buildWhere(query);
    await this.applyScope(where, user, 'read');
    const sortBy = query.sortBy ?? 'createdAt';
    const sortOrder = query.sortOrder ?? 'desc';
    const orderBy: any = {
      [sortBy]: sortOrder,
    };

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.deal.findMany({
        where,
        include: { customer: true, assignedTo: true },
        orderBy,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.deal.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows.map((d) => this.mapDeal(d)),
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  /** Pipeline dạng Kanban: nhóm cơ hội đang mở theo từng stage */
  async pipeline(user: RequestUser, query: QueryDealDto) {
    const where = this.buildWhere({ ...query, stage: undefined });
    await this.applyScope(where, user, 'read');

    const rows = await this.prisma.deal.findMany({
      where,
      include: { customer: true, assignedTo: true },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    const columns = ALL_STAGES.map((stage) => {
      const deals = rows
        .filter((d) => d.stage === stage)
        .map((d) => this.mapDeal(d));
      const value = deals.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.value || 0), 0);
      return { stage, count: deals.length, value, deals };
    });

    return columns;
  }

  async findOne(user: RequestUser, id: string) {
    const deal = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        customer: true,
        assignedTo: true,
        activities: {
          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
          include: { createdBy: { include: { employee: true } } },
        },
      },
    });
    if (!deal) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'read', deal);
    return this.mapDeal(deal);
  }

  async create(dto: CreateDealDto, createdById?: string) {
    await this.validateCustomer(dto.customerId);
    await this.validateAssignee(dto.assignedToId);

    const stage = dto.stage ?? 'prospecting';
    const status = this.statusFromStage(stage);
    const probability = dto.probability ?? STAGE_PROBABILITY[stage] ?? 0;

    // nextDealCode() có khoảng hở TOCTOU giống nextCustomerCode() — bọc
    // bằng createWithSequentialCodeRetry để tự sinh mã mới khi hai request
    // tạo cơ hội cùng lúc va vào cùng một mã CH-xxxx.
    const deal = await createWithSequentialCodeRetry(
      () => this.nextDealCode(),
      (code) =>
        this.prisma.deal.create({
          data: {
            code,
            name: dto.name,
            customerId: dto.customerId,
            value: dto.value ?? 0,
            probability,
            stage,
            status,
            source: dto.source ?? null,
            expectedCloseDate: dto.expectedCloseDate
              ? new Date(dto.expectedCloseDate)
              : null,
            closedAt: status !== 'open' ? new Date() : null,
            description: dto.description ?? null,
            assignedToId: dto.assignedToId ?? null,
            createdById: createdById ?? null,
            activities: {
              create: {
                type: 'created',
                content: 'Đã tạo cơ hội bán hàng',
                toStage: stage,
                createdById: createdById ?? null,
              },
            },
          },
          include: { customer: true, assignedTo: true },
        }),
    );

    return this.mapDeal(deal);
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateDealDto, user: RequestUser) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { assignedTo: true },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'update', existing);

    if (dto.customerId !== undefined) {
      await this.validateCustomer(dto.customerId);
    }
    if (dto.assignedToId !== undefined) {
      await this.validateAssignee(dto.assignedToId);
    }

    const data: any = {};
    if (dto.name !== undefined) data.name = dto.name;
    if (dto.value !== undefined) data.value = dto.value;
    if (dto.probability !== undefined) data.probability = dto.probability;
    if (dto.source !== undefined) data.source = dto.source || null;
    if (dto.description !== undefined)
      data.description = dto.description || null;
    if (dto.lostReason !== undefined) data.lostReason = dto.lostReason || null;
    if (dto.expectedCloseDate !== undefined) {
      data.expectedCloseDate = dto.expectedCloseDate
        ? new Date(dto.expectedCloseDate)
        : null;
    }
    if (dto.customerId !== undefined) {
      data.customer = { connect: { id: dto.customerId } };
    }
    if (dto.assignedToId !== undefined) {
      data.assignedTo = dto.assignedToId
        ? { connect: { id: dto.assignedToId } }
        : { disconnect: true };
    }

    // Nếu đổi stage qua update -> đồng bộ status/closedAt và ghi lịch sử
    let stageChanged = false;
    if (dto.stage !== undefined && dto.stage !== existing.stage) {
      stageChanged = true;
      const status = this.statusFromStage(dto.stage);
      data.stage = dto.stage;
      data.status = status;
      data.closedAt = status !== 'open' ? new Date() : null;
      if (dto.probability === undefined && dto.stage === 'closed_won')
        data.probability = 100;
      if (dto.probability === undefined && dto.stage === 'closed_lost')
        data.probability = 0;
      // Rời khỏi "Thất bại" (đổi sang stage khác) mà không có lostReason mới
      // -> xóa lý do thất bại cũ, tránh hiển thị lostReason lỗi thời trên
      // một cơ hội đã được mở lại. Nếu dto có gửi lostReason kèm theo, giá
      // trị đó (đã gán ở nhánh phía trên) được giữ nguyên, không bị ghi đè.
      if (dto.stage !== 'closed_lost' && dto.lostReason === undefined) {
        data.lostReason = null;
      }
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.deal.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
      include: { customer: true, assignedTo: true },
    });

    if (stageChanged) {
      await this.prisma.dealActivity.create({
        data: {
          dealId: id,
          type: 'stage_change',
          content: 'Cập nhật giai đoạn cơ hội',
          fromStage: existing.stage,
          toStage: dto.stage,
          createdById: user.userId ?? null,
        },
      });
    }

    return this.mapDeal(updated);
  }

  /** Chuyển cơ hội sang giai đoạn khác (kéo thả Kanban) + ghi lịch sử */
  async moveStage(id: string, dto: MoveStageDto, user: RequestUser) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { assignedTo: true },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'update', existing);

    if (dto.stage === existing.stage) {
      return this.findOne(user, id);
    }

    const status = this.statusFromStage(dto.stage);
    const data: any = {
      stage: dto.stage,
      status,
      closedAt: status !== 'open' ? new Date() : null,
    };
    if (dto.stage === 'closed_won') data.probability = 100;
    if (dto.stage === 'closed_lost') {
      data.probability = 0;
      data.lostReason = dto.lostReason ?? existing.lostReason ?? null;
    } else {
      // Chuyển sang bất kỳ stage nào khác "Thất bại" -> xóa lostReason cũ
      // (nếu có), tránh cơ hội được mở lại vẫn còn mang lý do thất bại cũ.
      data.lostReason = null;
    }

    await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.deal.update({ where: { id }, data }),
      this.prisma.dealActivity.create({
        data: {
          dealId: id,
          type: 'stage_change',
          content:
            dto.stage === 'closed_lost' && dto.lostReason
              ? `Chuyển sang "Thất bại": ${dto.lostReason}`
              : 'Chuyển giai đoạn cơ hội',
          fromStage: existing.stage,
          toStage: dto.stage,
          createdById: user.userId ?? null,
        },
      }),
    ]);

    return this.findOne(user, id);
  }

  /** Thêm hoạt động / ghi chú cho cơ hội */
  async addActivity(id: string, dto: CreateActivityDto, user: RequestUser) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { assignedTo: true },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'update', existing);

    await this.prisma.dealActivity.create({
      data: {
        dealId: id,
        type: dto.type,
        content: dto.content,
        createdById: user.userId ?? null,
      },
    });

    return this.findOne(user, id);
  }

  /** Danh sách hoạt động của một cơ hội */
  async activities(user: RequestUser, id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { assignedTo: true },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'read', existing);

    const rows = await this.prisma.dealActivity.findMany({
      where: { dealId: id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      include: { createdBy: { include: { employee: true } } },
    });
    return rows.map((a) => this.mapActivity(a));
  }

  /** Xoá mềm cơ hội */
  async remove(user: RequestUser, id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.deal.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { assignedTo: true },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy cơ hội.');
    await this.assertInScope(user, 'delete', existing);

    await this.prisma.deal.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date() },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa cơ hội.' };
  }

  /** Danh sách nhân viên có thể phân công phụ trách cơ hội */
  async assignees() {
    return this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: { archivedAt: null },
      select: {
        id: true,
        code: true,
        fullName: true,
        avatarUrl: true,
        jobTitle: true,
      },
      orderBy: { fullName: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  /** Danh sách khách hàng gọn (phục vụ dropdown chọn khách hàng cho cơ hội) */
  async customers(search?: string) {
    const where: any = { deletedAt: null };
    if (search && search.trim()) {
      const term = search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { code: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }
    return this.prisma.customer.findMany({
      where,
      select: { id: true, code: true, name: true, type: true },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      take: 200,
    });
  }

  /** Thống kê tổng hợp cơ hội (dashboard, funnel, dự báo doanh thu) */
  async stats() {
    const grouped = await this.prisma.deal.groupBy({
      by: ['stage'],
      where: { deletedAt: null },
      _count: { _all: true },
      _sum: { value: true },
    });

    const byStage = ALL_STAGES.map((stage) => {
      const g = grouped.find((x) => x.stage === stage);
      return {
        stage,
        count: g?._count._all ?? 0,
        value: g?._sum.value ? Number(g._sum.value) : 0,
      };
    });

    // Cơ hội đang mở (để tính giá trị & dự báo có trọng số)
    const openDeals = await this.prisma.deal.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null, status: 'open' },
      select: { value: true, probability: true },
    });
    const totalOpen = openDeals.length;
    const totalOpenValue = openDeals.reduce(
      (s, d) => s + (d.value ? Number(d.value) : 0),
      0,
    );
    const weightedForecast = openDeals.reduce(
      (s, d) => s + (d.value ? Number(d.value) : 0) * (d.probability / 100),
      0,
    );

    const won = byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_won')!;
    const lost = byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_lost')!;
    const closedTotal = won.count + lost.count;
    const conversionRate =
      closedTotal > 0 ? Math.round((won.count / closedTotal) * 100) : 0;

    return {
      totalOpen,
      totalOpenValue,
      wonCount: won.count,
      wonValue: won.value,
      lostCount: lost.count,
      conversionRate,
      weightedForecast: Math.round(weightedForecast),
      byStage,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IsIn, IsString, MaxLength, MinLength } from 'class-validator';
import type { DealActivityType } from '@comtech/types';

const ACTIVITY_TYPES: DealActivityType[] = [
  'note',
  'call',
  'email',
  'meeting',
  'task',
];

/**
 * DTO thêm hoạt động / ghi chú cho cơ hội.
 */
export class CreateActivityDto {
  @IsIn(ACTIVITY_TYPES, { message: 'Loại hoạt động không hợp lệ.' })
  type: DealActivityType;

  @IsString({ message: 'Vui lòng nhập nội dung.' })
  @MinLength(1, { message: 'Nội dung không được để trống.' })
  @MaxLength(2000, { message: 'Nội dung quá dài.' })
  content: string;
}
```

```typescript
import {
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsISO8601,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  Max,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
  MinLength,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import type { DealSource, DealStage } from '@comtech/types';

export const DEAL_STAGES: DealStage[] = [
  'prospecting',
  'qualification',
  'proposal',
  'negotiation',
  'closed_won',
  'closed_lost',
];

export const DEAL_SOURCES: DealSource[] = [
  'website',
  'referral',
  'event',
  'cold_call',
  'social',
  'other',
];

export class CreateDealDto {
  @IsString({ message: 'Vui lòng nhập tên cơ hội.' })
  @MinLength(2, { message: 'Tên cơ hội quá ngắn.' })
  @MaxLength(255, { message: 'Tên cơ hội quá dài.' })
  name: string;

  @IsUUID('4', { message: 'Khách hàng không hợp lệ.' })
  customerId: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsNumber({}, { message: 'Giá trị cơ hội không hợp lệ.' })
  @Min(0, { message: 'Giá trị cơ hội không được âm.' })
  value?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsInt({ message: 'Xác suất phải là số nguyên.' })
  @Min(0, { message: 'Xác suất tối thiểu là 0%.' })
  @Max(100, { message: 'Xác suất tối đa là 100%.' })
  probability?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_STAGES, { message: 'Giai đoạn không hợp lệ.' })
  stage?: DealStage;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_SOURCES, { message: 'Nguồn cơ hội không hợp lệ.' })
  source?: DealSource;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsISO8601({}, { message: 'Ngày đóng dự kiến không hợp lệ.' })
  expectedCloseDate?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  description?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID('4', { message: 'Người phụ trách không hợp lệ.' })
  assignedToId?: string;
}
```

### `apps/api/src/deals/dto/query-deal.dto.ts`

```typescript
import { IsIn, IsOptional, IsString } from 'class-validator';
import type { DealStage, DealStatus } from '@comtech/types';
import { DEAL_STAGES } from './create-deal.dto';

const DEAL_STATUSES: DealStatus[] = ['open', 'won', 'lost'];

/**
 * Tham số lọc/tìm kiếm/phân trang cho danh sách cơ hội.
 */
export class QueryDealDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  page?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  pageSize?: string;

  /** Từ khoá tìm kiếm (tên, mã cơ hội, tên/mã khách hàng). */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  search?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_STAGES, { message: 'Giai đoạn không hợp lệ.' })
  stage?: DealStage;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_STATUSES, { message: 'Trạng thái không hợp lệ.' })
  status?: DealStatus;

  /** Lọc theo người phụ trách (id nhân viên). */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  assignedToId?: string;

  /** Lọc theo khách hàng. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  customerId?: string;

  /** Giá trị tối thiểu. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  minValue?: string;

  /** Giá trị tối đa. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  maxValue?: string;

  /** Sắp xếp: createdAt | value | expectedCloseDate | probability | name. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['createdAt', 'value', 'expectedCloseDate', 'probability', 'name'])
  sortBy?: 'createdAt' | 'value' | 'expectedCloseDate' | 'probability' | 'name';

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['asc', 'desc'])
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}
```

```typescript
import {
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsISO8601,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  Max,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
  MinLength,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import type { DealSource, DealStage } from '@comtech/types';
import { DEAL_SOURCES, DEAL_STAGES } from './create-deal.dto';

/**
 * DTO cập nhật cơ hội — tất cả trường đều tùy chọn (PATCH).
 */
export class UpdateDealDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString({ message: 'Vui lòng nhập tên cơ hội.' })
  @MinLength(2, { message: 'Tên cơ hội quá ngắn.' })
  @MaxLength(255, { message: 'Tên cơ hội quá dài.' })
  name?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID('4', { message: 'Khách hàng không hợp lệ.' })
  customerId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsNumber({}, { message: 'Giá trị cơ hội không hợp lệ.' })
  @Min(0, { message: 'Giá trị cơ hội không được âm.' })
  value?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsInt({ message: 'Xác suất phải là số nguyên.' })
  @Min(0, { message: 'Xác suất tối thiểu là 0%.' })
  @Max(100, { message: 'Xác suất tối đa là 100%.' })
  probability?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_STAGES, { message: 'Giai đoạn không hợp lệ.' })
  stage?: DealStage;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(DEAL_SOURCES, { message: 'Nguồn cơ hội không hợp lệ.' })
  source?: DealSource;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsISO8601({}, { message: 'Ngày đóng dự kiến không hợp lệ.' })
  expectedCloseDate?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  description?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(500, { message: 'Lý do thất bại quá dài.' })
  lostReason?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID('4', { message: 'Người phụ trách không hợp lệ.' })
  assignedToId?: string;
}
```
