```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { DepartmentsController } from './departments.controller';
import { DepartmentsService } from './departments.service';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

describe('DepartmentsController', () => {
  let controller: DepartmentsController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  const reflector = new Reflector();

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      create: jest.fn(),
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      getHierarchy: jest.fn(),
      stats: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn(),
      remove: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [DepartmentsController],
      providers: [{ provide: DepartmentsService, useValue: service }],
    }).compile();

    controller = module.get(DepartmentsController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('delegation to service', () => {
    it('create() delegates to service.create with the dto', async () => {
      service.create.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { code: 'PB-0001', name: 'Kỹ thuật' } as any;

      const result = await controller.create(dto);

      expect(service.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto);
      expect(result).toEqual({ id: '1' });
    });

    it('findAll() delegates to service.findAll with the query', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [] });
      const query = { page: 1 } as any;

      await controller.findAll(query);

      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
    });

    it('getHierarchy() delegates to service.getHierarchy', async () => {
      service.getHierarchy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      await controller.getHierarchy();
      expect(service.getHierarchy).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('getStats() delegates to service.stats', async () => {
      service.stats.mockResolvedValue({ total: 0 });
      await controller.getStats();
      expect(service.stats).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('findOne() delegates to service.findOne with the id', async () => {
      service.findOne.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      await controller.findOne('1');
      expect(service.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });

    it('update() delegates to service.update with id and dto', async () => {
      service.update.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { name: 'New name' } as any;
      await controller.update('1', dto);
      expect(service.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', dto);
    });

    it('remove() delegates to service.remove with the id', async () => {
      service.remove.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      await controller.remove('1');
      expect(service.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });
  });

  describe('RBAC metadata (roles required per route)', () => {
    it('restricts create to admin and hr', () => {
      const roles = reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.create);
      expect(roles).toEqual(['admin', 'hr']);
    });

    it('restricts update to admin and hr', () => {
      const roles = reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.update);
      expect(roles).toEqual(['admin', 'hr']);
    });

    it('restricts remove to admin and hr', () => {
      const roles = reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.remove);
      expect(roles).toEqual(['admin', 'hr']);
    });

    it('leaves findAll unrestricted (any authenticated role can read)', () => {
      const roles = reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.findAll);
      expect(roles).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('leaves findOne unrestricted (any authenticated role can read)', () => {
      const roles = reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.findOne);
      expect(roles).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Patch,
  Delete,
  Param,
  Body,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiTags,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { DepartmentsService } from './departments.service';
import { CreateDepartmentDto } from './dto/create-department.dto';
import { UpdateDepartmentDto } from './dto/update-department.dto';
import { QueryDepartmentDto } from './dto/query-department.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

@ApiTags('departments')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('departments')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
export class DepartmentsController {
  constructor(private readonly departmentsService: DepartmentsService) {}

  @Post()
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Tạo phòng ban mới (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Tạo thành công' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Mã trùng, phòng ban cha/quản lý không hợp lệ',
  })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateDepartmentDto) {
    return this.departmentsService.create(dto);
  }

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Danh sách phòng ban (phân trang, tìm kiếm, lọc theo phòng cha)',
  })
  async findAll(@Query() query: QueryDepartmentDto) {
    return this.departmentsService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('hierarchy/tree')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cây phân cấp đầy đủ của tất cả phòng ban' })
  async getHierarchy() {
    return this.departmentsService.getHierarchy();
  }

  @Get('stats/summary')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Thống kê tổng số phòng ban, phòng gốc, nhân viên' })
  async getStats() {
    return this.departmentsService.stats();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Chi tiết một phòng ban (kèm phòng con, danh sách nhân viên)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Không tìm thấy phòng ban' })
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.departmentsService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cập nhật phòng ban (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Vi phạm cấu trúc vòng tròn hoặc mã trùng',
  })
  async update(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() dto: UpdateDepartmentDto) {
    return this.departmentsService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Xóa mềm phòng ban (chỉ admin/hr, phải rỗng nhân viên và phòng con)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Phòng ban vẫn còn nhân viên hoặc phòng con',
  })
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.departmentsService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { BadRequestException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DepartmentsService } from './departments.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

type MockPrisma = {
  department: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
};

describe('DepartmentsService', () => {
  let service: DepartmentsService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      department: {
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
        create: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
      },
      employee: {
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
      },
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        DepartmentsService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(DepartmentsService);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('create', () => {
    const dto = { code: 'PB-0001', name: 'Kỹ thuật' } as any;

    it('creates a department when code is unique and no parent/manager given', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      prisma.department.create.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Kỹ thuật',
        parent: null,
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.create(dto);

      expect(prisma.department.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.code).toBe('PB-0001');
      expect(result.employeeCount).toBe(0);
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when code already exists', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'existing' });

      await expect(service.create(dto)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(prisma.department.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when parentId does not reference an existing department', async () => {
      const dtoWithParent = { ...dto, parentId: 'missing-parent' };
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // parent lookup

      await expect(service.create(dtoWithParent)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when parent department is soft-deleted', async () => {
      const dtoWithParent = { ...dto, parentId: 'parent-1' };
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        id: 'parent-1',
        deletedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await expect(service.create(dtoWithParent)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when managerId does not reference an existing employee', async () => {
      const dtoWithManager = { ...dto, managerId: 'missing-manager' };
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(service.create(dtoWithManager)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException when manager is archived', async () => {
      const dtoWithManager = { ...dto, managerId: 'mgr-1' };
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'mgr-1',
        archivedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await expect(service.create(dtoWithManager)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('creates a department when a valid parent and active manager are both given', async () => {
      const dtoWithBoth = { ...dto, parentId: 'parent-1', managerId: 'mgr-1' };
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'parent-1', deletedAt: null }) // parent lookup
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // code uniqueness check
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'mgr-1',
        archivedAt: null,
      });
      prisma.department.create.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '2',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Kỹ thuật',
        parent: { id: 'parent-1', code: 'PB-0000', name: 'Root' },
        manager: { id: 'mgr-1', code: 'NV-0001', fullName: 'Manager' },
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.create(dtoWithBoth);

      expect(prisma.department.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.manager?.id).toBe('mgr-1');
    });
  });

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('returns paginated departments with default paging', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      const result = await service.findAll({} as any);

      expect(result.pagination).toEqual({
        page: 1,
        pageSize: 20,
        total: 0,
        pages: 0,
      });
      expect(prisma.department.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { deletedAt: null },
          skip: 0,
          take: 20,
        }),
      );
    });

    it('applies case-insensitive search across code and name', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ search: 'ky thuat' } as any);

      expect(prisma.department.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: {
            deletedAt: null,
            OR: [
              { code: { contains: 'ky thuat', mode: 'insensitive' } },
              { name: { contains: 'ky thuat', mode: 'insensitive' } },
            ],
          },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('filters by parentId when provided', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.findAll({ parentId: 'root-1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.department.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { deletedAt: null, parentId: 'root-1' },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('maps returned rows through mapDepartment when results are non-empty', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: '1',
          code: 'PB-0001',
          name: 'Kỹ thuật',
          parent: null,
          manager: null,
          _count: { employees: 4, children: 1 },
          createdAt: new Date(),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        },
      ]);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.findAll({} as any);

      expect(result.data).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result.data[0]).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({
          code: 'PB-0001',
          employeeCount: 4,
          childCount: 1,
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('findOne', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when department does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.findOne('missing')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('throws NotFoundException when department is soft-deleted', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        deletedAt: new Date(),
      });
      await expect(service.findOne('1')).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });

    it('returns mapped department detail when found', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Kỹ thuật',
        parent: null,
        children: [],
        manager: null,
        employees: [],
        _count: { employees: 2 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.findOne('1');
      expect(result.employeeCount).toBe(2);
    });

    it('defaults employeeCount to 0 when _count is missing', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Kỹ thuật',
        parent: null,
        children: [],
        manager: null,
        employees: [],
        _count: undefined,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.findOne('1');
      expect(result.employeeCount).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('update', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when updating a non-existent department', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.update('missing', { name: 'x' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });

    it('rejects setting a department as its own parent', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
      });

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { parentId: '1' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects circular hierarchy where the new parent is a descendant', async () => {
      // department being updated
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', code: 'PB-A' }) // load department A
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'B', deletedAt: null }) // parent lookup (B exists)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', children: [{ id: 'B' }] }); // isDescendant(A, B) -> A has child B

      await expect(
        service.update('A', { parentId: 'B' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects a new parent that does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: '1', code: 'PB-0001' }) // existing dept
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // parent lookup fails

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { parentId: 'missing-parent' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects a new parent that has been soft-deleted', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: '1', code: 'PB-0001' }) // existing dept
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'parent-1', deletedAt: new Date() }); // soft-deleted parent

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { parentId: 'parent-1' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('resolves a non-circular hierarchy by recursing through descendants before updating', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', code: 'PB-A' }) // load department A
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'C', deletedAt: null }) // parent lookup (C exists)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', children: [{ id: 'B' }] }) // isDescendant(A, C): A's direct child is B, not C
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'B', children: [] }); // isDescendant(B, C): B has no children -> false
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'A',
        code: 'PB-A',
        parent: { id: 'C', code: 'PB-C', name: 'C' },
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 1 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.update('A', { parentId: 'C' } as any);

      expect(prisma.department.update).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.code).toBe('PB-A');
    });

    it('rejects updating to a manager that does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
      });
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { managerId: 'missing-mgr' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects updating to a manager that is archived', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
      });
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'mgr-1',
        archivedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { managerId: 'mgr-1' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects duplicate code on update', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: '1', code: 'PB-0001' }) // existing dept
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'other' }); // code collision lookup

      await expect(
        service.update('1', { code: 'PB-9999' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('accepts a new unique code with no collision', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: '1', code: 'PB-0001' }) // existing dept
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // no collision
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-9999',
        parent: null,
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.update('1', { code: 'PB-9999' } as any);
      expect(result.code).toBe('PB-9999');
    });

    it('updates successfully with a valid, active manager', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
      });
      prisma.employee.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'mgr-1',
        archivedAt: null,
      });
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        parent: null,
        manager: { id: 'mgr-1', code: 'NV-0001', fullName: 'Manager' },
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.update('1', { managerId: 'mgr-1' } as any);
      expect(result.manager?.id).toBe('mgr-1');
    });

    it('updates successfully with valid data', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
      });
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Updated',
        parent: null,
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.update('1', { name: 'Updated' } as any);
      expect(result.name).toBe('Updated');
    });
  });

  describe('remove', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when department does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.remove('missing')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('rejects removal when department still has active employees', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(3);

      await expect(service.remove('1')).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('rejects removal when department has child departments', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(2);

      await expect(service.remove('1')).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('soft-deletes the department when no blockers exist', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.department.count.mockResolvedValue(0);
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        code: 'PB-0001',
        name: 'Kỹ thuật',
        parent: null,
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      await service.remove('1');
      expect(prisma.department.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: '1' },
          data: expect.objectContaining({ deletedAt: expect.any(Date) }),
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('stats', () => {
    it('aggregates department and employee counts', async () => {
      prisma.department.count
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(10) // total
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(3); // root
      prisma.employee.count.mockResolvedValue(50);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result).toEqual({
        total: 10,
        rootDepartments: 3,
        totalEmployees: 50,
      });
    });
  });

  describe('getHierarchy', () => {
    it('builds a nested tree from flat department rows', async () => {
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: 'root',
          parentId: null,
          code: 'PB-0001',
          name: 'Root',
          manager: null,
          _count: { employees: 1 },
        },
        {
          id: 'child',
          parentId: 'root',
          code: 'PB-0002',
          name: 'Child',
          manager: null,
          _count: { employees: 2 },
        },
      ]);

      const tree = await service.getHierarchy();

      expect(tree).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tree[0].id).toBe('root');
      expect(tree[0].children).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tree[0].children[0].id).toBe('child');
    });
  });

  describe('isDescendant edge cases (exercised via update)', () => {
    it('treats a missing node as having no descendants', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', code: 'PB-A' }) // load department A
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'C', deletedAt: null }) // parent lookup
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null); // isDescendant root lookup returns nothing
      prisma.department.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'A',
        code: 'PB-A',
        parent: { id: 'C', code: 'PB-C', name: 'C' },
        manager: null,
        _count: { employees: 0, children: 0 },
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      const result = await service.update('A', { parentId: 'C' } as any);
      expect(result.code).toBe('PB-A');
    });

    it('detects a circular reference two levels deep', async () => {
      prisma.department.findUnique
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', code: 'PB-A' }) // load department A
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'C', deletedAt: null }) // parent lookup (C exists)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'A', children: [{ id: 'B' }] }) // isDescendant(A, C): child B
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'B', children: [{ id: 'C' }] }); // isDescendant(B, C): child matches -> true

      await expect(
        service.update('A', { parentId: 'C' } as any),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/departments/departments.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Injectable,
  BadRequestException,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateDepartmentDto } from './dto/create-department.dto';
import { UpdateDepartmentDto } from './dto/update-department.dto';
import { QueryDepartmentDto } from './dto/query-department.dto';

@Injectable()
export class DepartmentsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async create(dto: CreateDepartmentDto) {
    // Validate parent department exists
    if (dto.parentId) {
      const parent = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
        where: { id: dto.parentId },
      });
      if (!parent || parent.deletedAt) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Phòng ban cha không tồn tại');
      }
    }

    // Validate manager exists and is an employee
    if (dto.managerId) {
      const manager = await this.prisma.employee.findUnique({
        where: { id: dto.managerId },
      });
      if (!manager || manager.archivedAt) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Quản lý không tồn tại');
      }
    }

    // Check code uniqueness
    const existingCode = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { code: dto.code },
    });
    if (existingCode) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Mã phòng ban đã tồn tại');
    }

    const department = await this.prisma.department.create({
      data: {
        code: dto.code,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        parentId: dto.parentId || null,
        managerId: dto.managerId || null,
      },
      include: {
        parent: { select: { id: true, code: true, name: true } },
        manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        _count: { select: { employees: true, children: true } },
      },
    });

    return this.mapDepartment(department);
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryDepartmentDto) {
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, search, parentId } = query;
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { deletedAt: null };

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { code: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    if (parentId) {
      where.parentId = parentId;
    }

    const [departments, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.department.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          parent: { select: { id: true, code: true, name: true } },
          manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
          _count: { select: { employees: true, children: true } },
        },
        orderBy: { code: 'asc' },
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.department.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: departments.map((d) => this.mapDepartment(d)),
      pagination: { page, pageSize, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        parent: { select: { id: true, code: true, name: true } },
        children: {
          where: { deletedAt: null },
          select: { id: true, code: true, name: true },
        },
        manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        employees: {
          where: { archivedAt: null },
          select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true, jobTitle: true },
        },
        _count: { select: { employees: true } },
      },
    });

    if (!department || department.deletedAt) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Phòng ban không tồn tại');
    }

    return this.mapDepartmentDetail(department);
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateDepartmentDto) {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!department || department.deletedAt) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Phòng ban không tồn tại');
    }

    // Validate parent department
    if (dto.parentId !== undefined && dto.parentId !== null) {
      // Check circular reference
      if (dto.parentId === id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Phòng ban không thể là cha của chính nó',
        );
      }

      const parent = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
        where: { id: dto.parentId },
      });
      if (!parent || parent.deletedAt) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Phòng ban cha không tồn tại');
      }

      // Check if parent is a child of this department (circular reference)
      const isCircular = await this.isDescendant(id, dto.parentId);
      if (isCircular) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Không thể tạo cấu trúc vòng tròn');
      }
    }

    // Validate manager
    if (dto.managerId !== undefined && dto.managerId !== null) {
      const manager = await this.prisma.employee.findUnique({
        where: { id: dto.managerId },
      });
      if (!manager || manager.archivedAt) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Quản lý không tồn tại');
      }
    }

    // Validate code uniqueness
    if (dto.code && dto.code !== department.code) {
      const existingCode = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
        where: { code: dto.code },
      });
      if (existingCode) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Mã phòng ban đã tồn tại');
      }
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.department.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        code: dto.code,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        parentId: dto.parentId,
        managerId: dto.managerId,
      },
      include: {
        parent: { select: { id: true, code: true, name: true } },
        manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        _count: { select: { employees: true, children: true } },
      },
    });

    return this.mapDepartment(updated);
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!department || department.deletedAt) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Phòng ban không tồn tại');
    }

    // Check if department has employees
    const employeeCount = await this.prisma.employee.count({
      where: { departmentId: id, archivedAt: null },
    });

    if (employeeCount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Phòng ban có ${employeeCount} nhân viên. Vui lòng chuyển nhân viên sang phòng khác trước khi xóa.`,
      );
    }

    // Check if department has children
    const childCount = await this.prisma.department.count({
      where: { parentId: id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (childCount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Phòng ban có ${childCount} phòng con. Vui lòng xóa phòng con trước khi xóa phòng ban này.`,
      );
    }

    const deleted = await this.prisma.department.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date() },
      include: {
        parent: { select: { id: true, code: true, name: true } },
        manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        _count: { select: { employees: true, children: true } },
      },
    });

    return this.mapDepartment(deleted);
  }

  async getHierarchy() {
    const departments = await this.prisma.department.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        manager: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        _count: { select: { employees: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { code: 'asc' },
    });

    // Build tree structure (only root departments)
    const roots = departments.filter((d) => !d.parentId);
    return roots.map((root) => this.buildTree(root, departments));
  }

  async stats() {
    const [total, rootCount, employeeCount] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.department.count({ where: { deletedAt: null } }),
      this.prisma.department.count({
        where: { deletedAt: null, parentId: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.employee.count({ where: { archivedAt: null } }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      rootDepartments: rootCount,
      totalEmployees: employeeCount,
    };
  }

  // Helper methods
  private mapDepartment(data: any) {
    return {
      id: data.id,
      code: data.code,
      name: data.name,
      description: data.description,
      parentId: data.parentId,
      parent: data.parent,
      manager: data.manager,
      employeeCount: data._count?.employees || 0,
      childCount: data._count?.children || 0,
      createdAt: data.createdAt,
      updatedAt: data.updatedAt,
    };
  }

  private mapDepartmentDetail(data: any) {
    return {
      id: data.id,
      code: data.code,
      name: data.name,
      description: data.description,
      parentId: data.parentId,
      parent: data.parent,
      manager: data.manager,
      children: data.children,
      employees: data.employees,
      employeeCount: data._count?.employees || 0,
      createdAt: data.createdAt,
      updatedAt: data.updatedAt,
    };
  }

  private buildTree(node: any, allNodes: any[]): any {
    const children = allNodes
      .filter((d) => d.parentId === node.id)
      .map((child) => this.buildTree(child, allNodes));

    return {
      id: node.id,
      code: node.code,
      name: node.name,
      manager: node.manager,
      employeeCount: node._count.employees,
      children: children.length > 0 ? children : [],
    };
  }

  private async isDescendant(
    parentId: string,
    potentialChildId: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const parent = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id: parentId },
      include: { children: true },
    });

    if (!parent) return false;

    for (const child of parent.children) {
      if (child.id === potentialChildId) return true;
      if (await this.isDescendant(child.id, potentialChildId)) return true;
    }

    return false;
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/employees/employees.controller.spec.ts`

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { EmployeesController } from './employees.controller';
import { EmployeesService } from './employees.service';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

describe('EmployeesController', () => {
  let controller: EmployeesController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  const reflector = new Reflector();

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      create: jest.fn(),
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      getOrgChart: jest.fn(),
      stats: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn(),
      remove: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [EmployeesController],
      providers: [{ provide: EmployeesService, useValue: service }],
    }).compile();

    controller = module.get(EmployeesController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('delegation to service', () => {
    it('create() delegates to service.create with the dto', async () => {
      service.create.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { fullName: 'Nguyen Van A' } as any;

      await controller.create(dto);

      expect(service.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto);
    });

    it('findAll() delegates to service.findAll with the query', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [] });
      const query = { page: 1 } as any;

      await controller.findAll(query);

      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
    });

    it('getOrgChart() delegates to service.getOrgChart', async () => {
      service.getOrgChart.mockResolvedValue([]);
      await controller.getOrgChart();
      expect(service.getOrgChart).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('getStats() delegates to service.stats', async () => {
      service.stats.mockResolvedValue({ total: 0 });
      await controller.getStats();
      expect(service.stats).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('findOne() delegates to service.findOne with the id', async () => {
      service.findOne.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      await controller.findOne('1');
      expect(service.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });

    it('update() delegates to service.update with id and dto', async () => {
      service.update.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { fullName: 'Updated' } as any;
      await controller.update('1', dto);
      expect(service.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', dto);
    });

    it('remove() delegates to service.remove with the id', async () => {
      service.remove.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });
      await controller.remove('1');
      expect(service.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });
  });

  describe('RBAC metadata (roles required per route)', () => {
    it('restricts create to admin and hr', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.create)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
    });

    it('restricts update to admin and hr', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.update)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
    });

    it('restricts remove to admin and hr', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.remove)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
    });

    it('leaves read endpoints unrestricted', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.findAll)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.findOne)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.getOrgChart)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.getStats)).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Patch,
  Delete,
  Param,
  Body,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiTags,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { EmployeesService } from './employees.service';
import { CreateEmployeeDto } from './dto/create-employee.dto';
import { UpdateEmployeeDto } from './dto/update-employee.dto';
import { QueryEmployeeDto } from './dto/query-employee.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

@ApiTags('employees')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('employees')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
export class EmployeesController {
  constructor(private readonly employeesService: EmployeesService) {}

  @Post()
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Tạo nhân viên mới, sinh mã tự động NV-XXXX (chỉ admin/hr)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Tạo thành công' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Phòng ban hoặc quản lý không hợp lệ',
  })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateEmployeeDto) {
    return this.employeesService.create(dto);
  }

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Danh sách nhân viên (phân trang, tìm kiếm, lọc trạng thái/phòng ban)',
  })
  async findAll(@Query() query: QueryEmployeeDto) {
    return this.employeesService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('org-chart')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Sơ đồ tổ chức dạng cây theo quan hệ quản lý' })
  async getOrgChart() {
    return this.employeesService.getOrgChart();
  }

  @Get('stats')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Thống kê nhân viên theo trạng thái và phòng ban' })
  async getStats() {
    return this.employeesService.stats();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Chi tiết một nhân viên (kèm danh sách cấp dưới trực tiếp)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Không tìm thấy nhân viên' })
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.employeesService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cập nhật thông tin nhân viên (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  async update(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() dto: UpdateEmployeeDto) {
    return this.employeesService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Lưu trữ (xóa mềm) nhân viên (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.employeesService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { BadRequestException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';

type MockPrisma = {

  department: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  $transaction: jest.Mock;
};

describe('EmployeesService', () => {

    it('allows clearing manager by passing an empty managerId', async () => {

        manager: null,

      await service.update('1', { workEmail: '' } as any);

      expect(prisma.employee.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({ workEmail: null }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('assigns non-empty simple field values as-is', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.employee.update.mockResolvedValue({

        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('remove', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when employee does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.remove('missing')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('soft-deletes (archives) the employee', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.employee.update.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.remove('1');

      expect(prisma.employee.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: '1' },
        data: { archivedAt: expect.any(Date) },
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('getOrgChart', () => {
    it('builds a hierarchical tree with only root nodes at the top level', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: 'boss',
          code: 'NV-0001',
          fullName: 'Boss',
          jobTitle: 'CEO',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: { name: 'Executive' },
          managerId: null,
          manager: { id: null },
          subordinates: [{ id: 'emp2' }],
        },
        {
          id: 'emp2',
          code: 'NV-0002',
          fullName: 'Employee',
          jobTitle: 'Dev',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: { name: 'Eng' },
          managerId: 'boss',
          manager: { id: 'boss' },
          subordinates: [],
        },
      ]);

      const tree = await service.getOrgChart();

      expect(tree).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tree[0].id).toBe('boss');
      expect(tree[0].children).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tree[0].children[0].id).toBe('emp2');
    });

    it('skips a subordinate reference that is not in the active employee set', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: 'boss',
          code: 'NV-0001',
          fullName: 'Boss',
          jobTitle: 'CEO',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: { name: 'Executive' },
          managerId: null,
          manager: { id: null },
          // references an archived/non-existent subordinate not present in this result set
          subordinates: [{ id: 'archived-employee' }],
        },
      ]);

      const tree = await service.getOrgChart();

      expect(tree).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tree[0].children).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('stats', () => {
    it('aggregates counts by status and department', async () => {
      prisma.employee.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { status: 'active', _count: { _all: 5 } },
        { status: 'probation', _count: { _all: 2 } },
      ]);
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: 'd1', code: 'PB-0001', name: 'Eng', employees: [1, 2] },
      ]);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result.total).toBe(7);
      expect(result.byStatus.active).toBe(5);
      expect(result.byStatus.probation).toBe(2);
      expect(result.departments[0].employeeCount).toBe(2);
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/employees/employees.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateEmployeeDto } from './dto/create-employee.dto';
import { UpdateEmployeeDto } from './dto/update-employee.dto';
import { QueryEmployeeDto } from './dto/query-employee.dto';
import { createWithSequentialCodeRetry } from '../common/utils/retry-on-conflict.util';

@Injectable()
export class EmployeesService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** Generate employee code: NV-0001 */
  private async nextEmployeeCode(): Promise<string> {
    const last = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { code: { startsWith: 'NV-' } },
      orderBy: { code: 'desc' },
    });
    const n = last ? parseInt(last.code.replace('NV-', ''), 10) + 1 : 1;
    return `NV-${String(n).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  }

  private mapEmployee(emp: any) {
    return {
      id: emp.id,
      code: emp.code,
      fullName: emp.fullName,
      avatarUrl: emp.avatarUrl,
      workEmail: emp.workEmail,
      companyPhone: emp.companyPhone,
      personalPhone: emp.personalPhone,
      emergencyContactPhone: emp.emergencyContactPhone,
      idCardAddress: emp.idCardAddress,
      currentAddress: emp.currentAddress,
      dateOfBirth: emp.dateOfBirth,
      gender: emp.gender,
      departmentId: emp.departmentId,
      jobTitle: emp.jobTitle,
      managerId: emp.managerId,
      status: emp.status,
      workArea: emp.workArea,
      notes: emp.notes,
      department: emp.department
        ? {
            id: emp.department.id,
            code: emp.department.code,
            name: emp.department.name,
          }
        : null,
      manager: emp.manager
        ? {
            id: emp.manager.id,
            code: emp.manager.code,
            fullName: emp.manager.fullName,
          }
        : null,
      createdAt: emp.createdAt,
      updatedAt: emp.updatedAt,
    };
  }

  private validateDepartment(deptId?: string) {
    if (!deptId) return;
    return this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id: deptId },
    });
  }

  private validateManager(managerId?: string) {
    if (!managerId) return;
    return this.prisma.employee.findUnique({
      where: { id: managerId },
    });
  }

  async create(dto: CreateEmployeeDto) {
    if (dto.departmentId) {
      const dept = await this.validateDepartment(dto.departmentId);
      if (!dept) throw new BadRequestException('Phòng ban không tồn tại.');
    }

    if (dto.managerId) {
      const manager = await this.validateManager(dto.managerId);
      if (!manager) throw new BadRequestException('Quản lý không tồn tại.');
    }

    // nextEmployeeCode() có khoảng hở TOCTOU giống các mã tuần tự khác
    // trong hệ thống — bọc bằng createWithSequentialCodeRetry để tự sinh mã
    // mới khi hai request tạo nhân viên cùng lúc va vào cùng một mã NV-xxxx.
    const employee = await createWithSequentialCodeRetry(
      () => this.nextEmployeeCode(),
      (code) =>
        this.prisma.employee.create({
          data: {
            code,
            fullName: dto.fullName,
            workEmail: dto.workEmail ?? null,
            companyPhone: dto.companyPhone ?? null,
            personalPhone: dto.personalPhone ?? null,
            emergencyContactPhone: dto.emergencyContactPhone ?? null,
            idCardAddress: dto.idCardAddress ?? null,
            currentAddress: dto.currentAddress ?? null,
            dateOfBirth: dto.dateOfBirth ?? null,
            gender: dto.gender ?? null,
            departmentId: dto.departmentId ?? null,
            jobTitle: dto.jobTitle ?? null,
            managerId: dto.managerId ?? null,
            status: 'probation',
            workArea: dto.workArea ?? null,
            notes: dto.notes ?? null,
          },
          include: { department: true, manager: true },
        }),
    );

    return this.mapEmployee(employee);
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryEmployeeDto) {
    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 100);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { archivedAt: null };

    if (query.status) where.status = query.status;
    if (query.departmentId) where.departmentId = query.departmentId;
    if (query.jobTitle)
      where.jobTitle = { contains: query.jobTitle, mode: 'insensitive' };

    if (query.search && query.search.trim()) {
      const term = query.search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { fullName: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { code: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { workEmail: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { companyPhone: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const sortBy = query.sortBy ?? 'createdAt';
    const sortOrder = query.sortOrder ?? 'desc';
    const orderBy: any = {
      [sortBy]: sortOrder,
    };

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.employee.findMany({
        where,
        include: { department: true, manager: true },
        orderBy,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.employee.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows.map((e) => this.mapEmployee(e)),
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const employee = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { id, archivedAt: null },
      include: { department: true, manager: true, subordinates: true },
    });

    if (!employee) throw new NotFoundException('Nhân viên không tồn tại.');

    return {
      ...this.mapEmployee(employee),
      subordinates: employee.subordinates.map((sub) => ({
        id: sub.id,
        code: sub.code,
        fullName: sub.fullName,
        jobTitle: sub.jobTitle,
      })),
    };
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateEmployeeDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { id, archivedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Nhân viên không tồn tại.');

    if (dto.departmentId !== undefined) {
      const dept = await this.validateDepartment(dto.departmentId);
      if (dto.departmentId && !dept) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Phòng ban không tồn tại.');
      }
    }

    if (dto.managerId !== undefined) {
      // Chặn tự đặt mình làm quản lý của chính mình — nếu không, nhân viên
      // này sẽ biến mất khỏi sơ đồ tổ chức (getOrgChart() chỉ liệt kê nhân
      // viên không có quản lý làm gốc, nên một nút tự tham chiếu sẽ không
      // bao giờ được duyệt tới từ bất kỳ gốc nào).
      if (dto.managerId && dto.managerId === id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Nhân viên không thể là quản lý của chính mình.',
        );
      }
      const manager = await this.validateManager(dto.managerId);
      if (dto.managerId && !manager) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Quản lý không tồn tại.');
      }
    }

    const data: any = {};
    const assignable: (keyof UpdateEmployeeDto)[] = [
      'fullName',
      'workEmail',
      'companyPhone',
      'personalPhone',
      'emergencyContactPhone',
      'idCardAddress',
      'currentAddress',
      'dateOfBirth',
      'gender',
      'jobTitle',
      'status',
      'workArea',
      'notes',
    ];

    for (const key of assignable) {
      if (dto[key] !== undefined) {
        data[key] = dto[key] === '' ? null : dto[key];
      }
    }

    if (dto.departmentId !== undefined) {
      data.department = dto.departmentId
        ? { connect: { id: dto.departmentId } }
        : { disconnect: true };
    }

    if (dto.managerId !== undefined) {
      data.manager = dto.managerId
        ? { connect: { id: dto.managerId } }
        : { disconnect: true };
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.employee.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
      include: { department: true, manager: true },
    });

    return this.mapEmployee(updated);
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { id, archivedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Nhân viên không tồn tại.');

    await this.prisma.employee.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { archivedAt: new Date() },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa nhân viên.' };
  }

  async getOrgChart() {
    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: { archivedAt: null },
      include: {
        manager: { select: { id: true } },
        subordinates: { select: { id: true } },
        department: true,
      },
      orderBy: { fullName: 'asc' },
    });

    // Build tree structure
    const employeeMap = new Map<string, any>(
      employees.map((e) => [
        e.id,
        {
          id: e.id,
          code: e.code,
          fullName: e.fullName,
          jobTitle: e.jobTitle,
          avatarUrl: e.avatarUrl,
          department: e.department?.name,
          managerId: e.managerId,
          children: [] as any[],
        },
      ]),
    );

    // Attach children
    for (const emp of employees) {
      for (const sub of emp.subordinates) {
        const parent = employeeMap.get(emp.id);
        const child = employeeMap.get(sub.id);
        if (parent && child) {
          parent.children.push(child);
        }
      }
    }

    // Return root nodes (employees with no manager)
    return Array.from(employeeMap.values()).filter((e: any) => !e.managerId);
  }

  async stats() {
    const grouped = await this.prisma.employee.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      where: { archivedAt: null },
      _count: { _all: true },
    });

    const byStatus: Record<string, number> = {
      probation: 0,
      active: 0,
      on_leave: 0,
      resigned: 0,
    };

    let total = 0;
    for (const g of grouped) {
      byStatus[g.status] = g._count._all;
      total += g._count._all;
    }

    const byDepartment = await this.prisma.department.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        employees: { where: { archivedAt: null } },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    return {
      total,
      byStatus,
      departments: byDepartment.map((d) => ({
        id: d.id,
        code: d.code,
        name: d.name,
        employeeCount: d.employees.length,
      })),
    };
  }
}
```

### `apps/api/src/main.ts`

```typescript
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import compression from 'compression';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
import { HttpExceptionFilter } from './common/filters/http-exception.filter';

/**
 * Kiểm tra các biến môi trường bắt buộc TRƯỚC KHI khởi tạo ứng dụng.
 *
 * Quan trọng nhất là JWT_SECRET: trước đây JwtStrategy và JwtModule đều có
 * fallback `?? 'change-me'` — nếu quên cấu hình biến môi trường ở một môi
 * trường thật, ứng dụng vẫn khởi động bình thường nhưng xác thực token bằng
 * một secret cố định, công khai trong mã nguồn. Thà dừng khởi động ngay và
 * báo lỗi rõ ràng còn hơn chạy "được" nhưng không an toàn.
 *
 * Không kiểm tra JWT_REFRESH_SECRET ở đây: refresh token trong hệ thống này
 * KHÔNG phải JWT — đó là chuỗi ngẫu nhiên (crypto.randomBytes) được hash và
 * lưu trong bảng refresh_tokens (xem AuthService.issueRefreshToken), nên
 * biến này hiện không được mã nguồn nào đọc tới dù vẫn còn trong
 * .env.example cho mục đích dự phòng/tương lai.
 */
function assertRequiredEnv() {
  const required = ['JWT_SECRET'];
  const missing = required.filter(
    (key) => !process.env[key] || process.env[key]!.length < 16,
  );
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.error(
      `❌ Thiếu (hoặc quá ngắn, <16 ký tự) biến môi trường bắt buộc: ${missing.join(', ')}. ` +
        'Xem .env.example để cấu hình trước khi khởi động API.',
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

async function bootstrap() {
  assertRequiredEnv();
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);

  app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
  // Header bảo mật HTTP chuẩn (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options,
  // ẩn X-Powered-By, HSTS khi HTTPS...). Tắt CSP mặc định của helmet vì API
  // thuần JSON không phục vụ HTML — CSP nên được cấu hình riêng ở tầng
  // frontend (Next.js) nếu cần, không phải ở đây.
  app.use(helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false }));
  app.use(cookieParser());
  // Nén response (gzip) — giảm băng thông và thời gian phản hồi cho các
  // danh sách lớn (employees, tasks, deals...) mà không đổi API contract.
  app.use(compression());

  app.enableCors({
    origin: process.env.WEB_ORIGIN?.split(',') ?? ['http://localhost:3000'],
    credentials: true,
  });

  app.useGlobalPipes(
    new ValidationPipe({
      whitelist: true,
      transform: true,
      forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
    }),
  );

  // Chuẩn hóa MỌI response lỗi (validation, business rule, lỗi hệ thống)
  // về cùng một cấu trúc JSON để frontend xử lý nhất quán.
  app.useGlobalFilters(new HttpExceptionFilter());

  // Tài liệu API (Swagger/OpenAPI) — chỉ bật ngoài môi trường production để
  // tránh lộ cấu trúc API ra ngoài không cần thiết.
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    const config = new DocumentBuilder()
      .setTitle('COMTECH CRM API')
      .setDescription(
        'API quản lý khách hàng, cơ hội bán hàng, nhân sự, phòng ban và công việc cho COMTECH Vietnam.',
      )
      .setVersion('1.0')
      .addBearerAuth(
        {
          type: 'http',
          scheme: 'bearer',
          bearerFormat: 'JWT',
          description: 'Nhập access token (không kèm tiền tố "Bearer ")',
        },
        'access-token',
      )
      .addTag('auth', 'Đăng nhập, refresh token, quên/đặt lại mật khẩu')
      .addTag('users', 'Quản lý tài khoản người dùng')
      .addTag('departments', 'Phòng ban — CRUD, cây phân cấp, thống kê')
      .addTag('employees', 'Nhân viên — CRUD, sơ đồ tổ chức, thống kê')
      .addTag('task-library', 'Mẫu công việc và công việc — CRUD, tiến độ')
      .addTag('customers', 'Khách hàng')
      .addTag('deals', 'Cơ hội bán hàng — pipeline, hoạt động')
      .addTag('dashboard', 'Số liệu tổng quan cho trang chủ')
      .addTag('reports', 'Báo cáo khách hàng, doanh số, hiệu suất nhân viên')
      .addTag('audit-log', 'Nhật ký hệ thống (chỉ admin)')
      .addTag('attendance', 'Chấm công — xác thực khuôn mặt + GPS')
      .addTag('notifications', 'Thông báo — thông báo nội bộ, nhắc sinh nhật')
      .build();

    const document = SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config);
    SwaggerModule.setup('api/docs', app, document, {
      swaggerOptions: {
        persistAuthorization: true,
      },
    });
  }

  const port = Number(process.env.API_PORT ?? 4000);
  await app.listen(port);
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  console.log(`🚀 COMTECH CRM API đang chạy tại http://localhost:${port}/api`);
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log(`📚 API docs: http://localhost:${port}/api/docs`);
  }
}

bootstrap();
```

```typescript
import { IsIn, IsString, Length } from 'class-validator';

export type NotificationTargetScope = 'all' | 'department';

export class CreateNotificationDto {
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 255)
  title: string;

  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 5000)
  message: string;

  /**
   * all: toàn công ty — cần duyệt (pending_approval), trừ khi người tạo có
   *      quyền notifications:approve:all thì tự động published.
   * department: chỉ phòng ban của người tạo — tự động published, không cần
   *      duyệt (bị ép về đúng phòng ban của người tạo, không thể chọn phòng
   *      ban khác).
   */
  @IsIn(['all', 'department'])
  targetScope: NotificationTargetScope;
}
```

```typescript
import { IsInt, IsOptional, Max, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';

export class QueryNotificationDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 1))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  page?: number = 1;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 20))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(200)
  pageSize?: number = 20;
}
```

```typescript
describe('NotificationsController', () => {

  };

    expect(service.unreadCount).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user);
    expect(result).toEqual({ count: 3 });
  });

  it('delegates markAllRead() to the service', async () => {
    service.markAllRead.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, markedCount: 2 });

    const result = await controller.markAllRead(user);

    expect(service.markAllRead).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user);
    expect(result).toEqual({ success: true, markedCount: 2 });
  });

  it('delegates markRead() to the service', async () => {
    service.markRead.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });

    const result = await controller.markRead(user, 'n1');

    expect(service.markRead).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, 'n1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ success: true });
  });

  it('delegates findPending() to the service', async () => {
    const query = { page: 1 } as any;
    service.findPending.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], total: 0 });

    const result = await controller.findPending(query);

    expect(service.findPending).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
    expect(result).toEqual({ data: [], total: 0 });
  });

  it('delegates approve() to the service', async () => {
    service.approve.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'n1', status: 'published' });

    const result = await controller.approve('n1');

    expect(service.approve).toHaveBeenCalledWith('n1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'n1', status: 'published' });
  });

  it('delegates reject() to the service', async () => {
    service.reject.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'n1', status: 'rejected' });

    expect(service.reject).toHaveBeenCalledWith('n1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'n1', status: 'rejected' });

  it('delegates remove() to the service with the current user', async () => {
    service.remove.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });

    const result = await controller.remove(user, 'n1');

    expect(service.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user, 'n1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ success: true });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/notifications/notifications.controller.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Post,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { NotificationsService } from './notifications.service';
import { CreateNotificationDto } from './dto/create-notification.dto';
import { QueryNotificationDto } from './dto/query-notification.dto';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  RequestUser,
} from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { RequirePermissions } from '../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';

@ApiTags('notifications')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('notifications')
export class NotificationsController {
  constructor(private readonly notificationsService: NotificationsService) {}

  @Post()
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:create')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Tạo thông báo mới (theo phòng ban hoặc toàn công ty)',
  })
  create(@CurrentUser() user: RequestUser, @Body() dto: CreateNotificationDto) {
    return this.notificationsService.create(user, dto);
  }

  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:read')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Danh sách thông báo hiển thị cho bản thân' })
  findMyFeed(
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
    @Query() query: QueryNotificationDto,
  ) {
    return this.notificationsService.findMyFeed(user, query);
  }

  @Get('unread-count')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:read')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Số lượng thông báo chưa đọc của bản thân' })
  unreadCount(@CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.notificationsService.unreadCount(user);
  }

  @Post('read-all')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:read')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Đánh dấu đã đọc tất cả thông báo' })
  markAllRead(@CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.notificationsService.markAllRead(user);
  }

  @Post(':id/read')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:read')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Đánh dấu đã đọc một thông báo' })
  markRead(
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
  ) {
    return this.notificationsService.markRead(user, id);
  }

  @Get('pending')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:approve')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Danh sách thông báo toàn công ty đang chờ duyệt' })
  findPending(@Query() query: QueryNotificationDto) {
    return this.notificationsService.findPending(query);
  }

  @Post(':id/approve')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:approve')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Duyệt thông báo chờ duyệt' })
  approve(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.notificationsService.approve(id);
  }

  @Post(':id/reject')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:approve')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Từ chối thông báo chờ duyệt' })
  reject(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.notificationsService.reject(id);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @RequirePermissions('notifications:create')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Xóa thông báo (chủ sở hữu hoặc người có quyền duyệt)',
  })
  remove(
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
  ) {
    return this.notificationsService.remove(user, id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ForbiddenException,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { NotificationsService } from './notifications.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

type MockPrisma = {
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  notification: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  notificationRead: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  $transaction: jest.Mock;
};

const buildUser = (permissions: string[]): RequestUser => ({
  userId: 'u1',
  email: 'user@comtech.vn',
  roles: ['employee'],
  permissions,
});

const employeeBase = {
  id: 'emp1',
  userId: 'u1',
  departmentId: 'd1',
  archivedAt: null,
};

describe('NotificationsService', () => {
  let service: NotificationsService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      employee: { findFirst: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      notification: {
        create: jest.fn(),
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
        delete: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
      },
      notificationRead: {
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        upsert: jest.fn(),
        createMany: jest.fn(),
      },
      $transaction: jest.fn((ops: Promise<any>[]) => Promise.all(ops)),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        NotificationsService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(NotificationsService);

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);

    it('forbids a non-owner without approve permission from deleting', async () => {

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  describe('generateBirthdayNotificationsForDate', () => {
```
