### `apps/api/src/notifications/notifications.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ForbiddenException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { CreateNotificationDto } from './dto/create-notification.dto';
import { QueryNotificationDto } from './dto/query-notification.dto';

@Injectable()
export class NotificationsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Trợ giúp chung
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  private async resolveEmployee(userId: string) {
    const employee = await this.prisma.employee.findFirst({
      where: { userId, archivedAt: null },
    });
    if (!employee) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Tài khoản của bạn chưa được liên kết với hồ sơ nhân viên.',
      );
    }
    return employee;
  }

  private canApproveAll(user: RequestUser): boolean {
    return (
      user.permissions?.some((p) =>
        p.startsWith('notifications:approve:all'),
      ) ?? false
    );
  }

  private mapNotification(n: any, isRead?: boolean) {
    return {
      id: n.id,
      type: n.type,
      title: n.title,
      message: n.message,
      status: n.status,
      targetScope: n.targetScope,
      targetDepartment: n.targetDepartment
        ? { id: n.targetDepartment.id, name: n.targetDepartment.name }
        : null,
      relatedEmployee: n.relatedEmployee
        ? {
            id: n.relatedEmployee.id,
            code: n.relatedEmployee.code,
            fullName: n.relatedEmployee.fullName,
            avatarUrl: n.relatedEmployee.avatarUrl,
          }
        : null,
      createdBy: n.createdBy
        ? {
            id: n.createdBy.id,
            code: n.createdBy.code,
            fullName: n.createdBy.fullName,
          }
        : null,
      publishedAt: n.publishedAt,
      createdAt: n.createdAt,
      isRead: isRead ?? undefined,
    };
  }

  private readonly includeForFeed = {
    targetDepartment: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
    relatedEmployee: {
      select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true, avatarUrl: true },
    },
    createdBy: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tạo thông báo
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async create(user: RequestUser, dto: CreateNotificationDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);

    if (dto.targetScope === 'department') {
      const now = new Date();
      const notification = await this.prisma.notification.create({
        data: {
          type: 'announcement',
          title: dto.title,
          message: dto.message,
          status: 'published',
          targetScope: 'department',
          targetDepartmentId: employee.departmentId,
          createdByEmployeeId: employee.id,
          publishedAt: now,
        },
        include: this.includeForFeed,
      });
      return this.mapNotification(notification);
    }

    // targetScope === 'all'
    const approved = this.canApproveAll(user);
    const now = new Date();
    const notification = await this.prisma.notification.create({
      data: {
        type: 'announcement',
        title: dto.title,
        message: dto.message,
        status: approved ? 'published' : 'pending_approval',
        targetScope: 'all',
        createdByEmployeeId: employee.id,
        publishedAt: approved ? now : null,
      },
      include: this.includeForFeed,
    });
    return this.mapNotification(notification);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Nguồn cấp dữ liệu của bản thân
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async findMyFeed(user: RequestUser, query: QueryNotificationDto) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);

    const where = {
      status: 'published',
      OR: [
        { targetScope: 'all' },
        {
          targetScope: 'department',
          targetDepartmentId: employee.departmentId,
        },
      ],
    };

    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 200);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.notification.findMany({
        where,
        include: this.includeForFeed,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.notification.count({ where }),
    ]);

    const reads = await this.prisma.notificationRead.findMany({
      where: {
        employeeId: employee.id,
        notificationId: { in: rows.map((r: any) => r.id) },
      },
      select: { notificationId: true },
    });
    const readSet = new Set(reads.map((r: any) => r.notificationId));

    return {
      data: rows.map((r: any) => this.mapNotification(r, readSet.has(r.id))),
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  async unreadCount(user: RequestUser) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);

    const visible = await this.prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: {
        status: 'published',
        OR: [
          { targetScope: 'all' },
          {
            targetScope: 'department',
            targetDepartmentId: employee.departmentId,
          },
        ],
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (visible.length === 0) return { count: 0 };

    const reads = await this.prisma.notificationRead.findMany({
      where: {
        employeeId: employee.id,
        notificationId: { in: visible.map((v: any) => v.id) },
      },
      select: { notificationId: true },
    });
    const readIds = new Set(reads.map((r: any) => r.notificationId));
    const count = visible.filter((v: any) => !readIds.has(v.id)).length;
    return { count };
  }

  async markRead(user: RequestUser, notificationId: string) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    const notification = await this.prisma.notification.findUnique({
      where: { id: notificationId },
    });
    if (!notification) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy thông báo.');

    await this.prisma.notificationRead.upsert({
      where: {
        notificationId_employeeId: { notificationId, employeeId: employee.id },
      },
      update: {},
      create: { notificationId, employeeId: employee.id },
    });
    return { success: true };
  }

  async markAllRead(user: RequestUser) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);

    const visible = await this.prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: {
        status: 'published',
        OR: [
          { targetScope: 'all' },
          {
            targetScope: 'department',
            targetDepartmentId: employee.departmentId,
          },
        ],
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    const existingReads = await this.prisma.notificationRead.findMany({
      where: {
        employeeId: employee.id,
        notificationId: { in: visible.map((v: any) => v.id) },
      },
      select: { notificationId: true },
    });
    const readIds = new Set(existingReads.map((r: any) => r.notificationId));
    const toCreate = visible.filter((v: any) => !readIds.has(v.id));

    if (toCreate.length > 0) {
      await this.prisma.notificationRead.createMany({
        data: toCreate.map((v: any) => ({
          notificationId: v.id,
          employeeId: employee.id,
        })),
        skipDuplicates: true,
      });
    }
    return { success: true, markedCount: toCreate.length };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Duyệt thông báo (chỉ quyền notifications:approve:all)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async findPending(query: QueryNotificationDto) {
    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 200);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where = { status: 'pending_approval' };
    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.notification.findMany({
        where,
        include: this.includeForFeed,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.notification.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows.map((r: any) => this.mapNotification(r)),
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  async approve(id: string) {
    const notification = await this.prisma.notification.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!notification) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy thông báo.');
    if (notification.status !== 'pending_approval') {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Thông báo này không ở trạng thái chờ duyệt.',
      );
    }
    const updated = await this.prisma.notification.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: 'published', publishedAt: new Date() },
      include: this.includeForFeed,
    });
    return this.mapNotification(updated);
  }

  async reject(id: string) {
    const notification = await this.prisma.notification.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!notification) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy thông báo.');
    if (notification.status !== 'pending_approval') {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Thông báo này không ở trạng thái chờ duyệt.',
      );
    }
    const updated = await this.prisma.notification.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: 'rejected' },
      include: this.includeForFeed,
    });
    return this.mapNotification(updated);
  }

  async remove(user: RequestUser, id: string) {
    const employee = await this.resolveEmployee(user.userId);
    const notification = await this.prisma.notification.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!notification) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy thông báo.');

    const isOwner = notification.createdByEmployeeId === employee.id;
    if (!isOwner && !this.canApproveAll(user)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Bạn không có quyền xóa thông báo này.');
    }

    await this.prisma.notification.delete({ where: { id } });
    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa thông báo.' };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sinh thông báo sinh nhật hằng ngày (tự động)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_7AM, { timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' })
  async generateBirthdayNotifications() {
    return this.generateBirthdayNotificationsForDate(new Date());
  }

  /** Tách riêng để test được không phụ thuộc vào ngày giờ thật */
  async generateBirthdayNotificationsForDate(referenceDate: Date) {
    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: { archivedAt: null, dateOfBirth: { not: null } },
      select: { id: true, fullName: true, dateOfBirth: true },
    });

    const isBirthday = (d: Date) =>
      d.getUTCMonth() === referenceDate.getUTCMonth() &&
      d.getUTCDate() === referenceDate.getUTCDate();

    const birthdayEmployees = employees.filter((e: any) =>
      isBirthday(e.dateOfBirth),
    );
    if (birthdayEmployees.length === 0) return { created: 0 };

    const dayStart = new Date(
      Date.UTC(
        referenceDate.getUTCFullYear(),
        referenceDate.getUTCMonth(),
        referenceDate.getUTCDate(),
      ),
    );
    const dayEnd = new Date(dayStart.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    let created = 0;
    for (const employee of birthdayEmployees) {
      const already = await this.prisma.notification.findFirst({
        where: {
          type: 'birthday',
          relatedEmployeeId: employee.id,
          createdAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd },
        },
      });
      if (already) continue;

      const now = new Date();
      await this.prisma.notification.create({
        data: {
          type: 'birthday',
          title: `🎂 Chúc mừng sinh nhật ${employee.fullName}!`,
          message: `Hôm nay là sinh nhật của ${employee.fullName}. Hãy gửi lời chúc mừng tới đồng nghiệp nhé!`,
          status: 'published',
          targetScope: 'all',
          relatedEmployeeId: employee.id,
          publishedAt: now,
        },
      });
      created += 1;
    }
    return { created };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IsIn, IsInt, IsOptional, IsUUID, Max, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';

export type ReportFormat = 'json' | 'csv';

/**
 * Bộ lọc dùng chung cho các báo cáo: thu hẹp theo phòng ban/nhân viên, và số
 * tháng gần nhất dùng để tính xu hướng theo thời gian (mặc định 6, tối đa 12).
 */
export class QueryReportDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID()
  departmentId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID()
  employeeId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 6))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(12)
  months?: number = 6;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['json', 'csv'])
  format?: ReportFormat = 'json';
}

export class QueryPerformanceReportDto extends QueryReportDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['revenue', 'tasksCompleted', 'completionRate'])
  sortBy?: 'revenue' | 'tasksCompleted' | 'completionRate' = 'revenue';

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 1))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  page?: number = 1;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(({ value }) => (value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 20))
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(100)
  pageSize?: number = 20;
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { ReportsController } from './reports.controller';
import { ReportsService } from './reports.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';

describe('ReportsController', () => {
  let controller: ReportsController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;

  const buildRes = () => {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    return {
      header: jest.fn((key: string, value: string) => {
        headers[key] = value;
      }),
      headers,
    } as any;
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      customers: jest.fn(),
      customersCsv: jest.fn(),
      sales: jest.fn(),
      salesCsv: jest.fn(),
      employeePerformance: jest.fn(),
      employeePerformanceCsv: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [ReportsController],
      providers: [{ provide: ReportsService, useValue: service }],
    })
      .overrideGuard(JwtAuthGuard)
      .useValue({ canActivate: () => true })
      .compile();

    controller = module.get(ReportsController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('customers', () => {
    it('delegates to the JSON report by default', async () => {
      const query = { months: 3 } as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.customers.mockResolvedValue({ total: 1 });

      const result = await controller.customers(query, res);

      expect(service.customers).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(service.customersCsv).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result).toEqual({ total: 1 });
      expect(res.header).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('streams a CSV download when format=csv', async () => {
      const query = { format: 'csv' } as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.customersCsv.mockResolvedValue('csv-content');

      const result = await controller.customers(query, res);

      expect(service.customersCsv).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(service.customers).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result).toBe('csv-content');
      expect(res.headers['Content-Type']).toBe('text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      expect(res.headers['Content-Disposition']).toContain(
        'bao-cao-khach-hang.csv',
      );
    });
  });

  describe('sales', () => {
    it('delegates to the JSON report by default', async () => {
      const query = {} as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.sales.mockResolvedValue({ winRate: 50 });

      const result = await controller.sales(query, res);

      expect(service.sales).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(result).toEqual({ winRate: 50 });
    });

    it('streams a CSV download when format=csv', async () => {
      const query = { format: 'csv' } as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.salesCsv.mockResolvedValue('csv-content');

      const result = await controller.sales(query, res);

      expect(service.salesCsv).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(result).toBe('csv-content');
      expect(res.headers['Content-Disposition']).toContain(
        'bao-cao-doanh-so.csv',
      );
    });
  });

  describe('employeePerformance', () => {
    it('delegates to the JSON report by default', async () => {
      const query = {} as any;
      const res = buildRes();
      service.employeePerformance.mockResolvedValue({ data: [] });

      const result = await controller.employeePerformance(query, res);

      expect(service.employeePerformance).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
      expect(result).toEqual({ data: [] });

    it('streams a CSV download when format=csv', async () => {

      expect(res.headers['Content-Disposition']).toContain(

  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/reports/reports.controller.ts`

```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Query, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { ReportsService } from './reports.service';
import {
  QueryPerformanceReportDto,
  QueryReportDto,
} from './dto/query-report.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';

@ApiTags('reports')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('reports')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class ReportsController {
  constructor(private readonly reportsService: ReportsService) {}

  @Get('customers')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Báo cáo khách hàng: theo trạng thái/loại/nguồn, xu hướng khách mới theo tháng',
  })
  async customers(
    @Query() query: QueryReportDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    if (query.format === 'csv') {
      const csv = await this.reportsService.customersCsv(query);
      res.header('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.header(
        'Content-Disposition',
        'attachment; filename="bao-cao-khach-hang.csv"',
      );
      return csv;
    }
    return this.reportsService.customers(query);
  }

  @Get('sales')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Báo cáo doanh số: theo giai đoạn, theo tháng, theo phòng ban, tỷ lệ chốt',
  })
  async sales(
    @Query() query: QueryReportDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    if (query.format === 'csv') {
      const csv = await this.reportsService.salesCsv(query);
      res.header('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.header(
        'Content-Disposition',
        'attachment; filename="bao-cao-doanh-so.csv"',
      );
      return csv;
    }
    return this.reportsService.sales(query);
  }

  @Get('employee-performance')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Báo cáo hiệu suất nhân viên: doanh số, công việc hoàn thành, tỷ lệ hoàn thành',
  })
  async employeePerformance(
    @Query() query: QueryPerformanceReportDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    if (query.format === 'csv') {
      const csv = await this.reportsService.employeePerformanceCsv(query);
      res.header('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.header(
        'Content-Disposition',
        'attachment; filename="bao-cao-hieu-suat-nhan-vien.csv"',
      );
      return csv;
    }
    return this.reportsService.employeePerformance(query);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { ReportsService } from './reports.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

type MockPrisma = {
  customer: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  deal: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  task: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  department: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
};

describe('ReportsService', () => {
  let service: ReportsService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      customer: { groupBy: jest.fn(), count: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      deal: { groupBy: jest.fn(), aggregate: jest.fn(), findMany: jest.fn() },
      task: { groupBy: jest.fn() },
      employee: { findMany: jest.fn() },
      department: { findMany: jest.fn() },
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [ReportsService, { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma }],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(ReportsService);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // customers()
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('customers', () => {
    const mockGroupBy = () => {
      prisma.customer.groupBy.mockImplementation(({ by }: any) => {
        if (by[0] === 'status') {
          return Promise.resolve([
            { status: 'lead', _count: { _all: 2 } },
            { status: 'active', _count: { _all: 3 } },
          ]);
        }
        if (by[0] === 'type') {
          return Promise.resolve([{ type: 'company', _count: { _all: 4 } }]);
        }
        return Promise.resolve([
          { source: 'website', _count: { _all: 1 } },
          { source: null, _count: { _all: 1 } },
        ]);
      });
    };

    it('aggregates status/type/source breakdowns and the monthly trend', async () => {
      mockGroupBy();
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(2);

      const result = await service.customers({ months: 1 } as any);

      expect(result.total).toBe(5);
      expect(result.byStatus).toEqual([
        { status: 'lead', count: 2 },
        { status: 'active', count: 3 },
      ]);
      expect(result.byType).toEqual([{ type: 'company', count: 4 }]);
      expect(result.bySource).toEqual([
        { source: 'website', count: 1 },
        { source: 'Không xác định', count: 1 },
      ]);
      expect(result.monthlyNew).toEqual([
        { month: expect.any(String), count: 2 },
      ]);
    });

    it('defaults to a 6-month trend window when months is not specified', async () => {
      mockGroupBy();
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      const result = await service.customers({} as any);

      expect(result.monthlyNew).toHaveLength(6);
    });

    it('scopes by employeeId', async () => {
      mockGroupBy();
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.customers({ months: 1, employeeId: 'e1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.customer.groupBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { deletedAt: null, assignedToId: 'e1' },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('scopes by departmentId when employeeId is absent', async () => {
      mockGroupBy();
      prisma.customer.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.customers({ months: 1, departmentId: 'd1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.customer.groupBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { deletedAt: null, assignedTo: { departmentId: 'd1' } },
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('customersCsv', () => {
    it('renders a CSV with one row per customer', async () => {
      prisma.customer.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          code: 'KH-0001',
          name: 'Công ty A',
          type: 'company',
          status: 'active',
          source: 'website',
          assignedTo: { fullName: 'Nguyễn A' },
          createdAt: new Date('2026-01-15T00:00:00Z'),
        },
        {
          code: 'KH-0002',
          name: 'Công ty B',
          type: 'company',
          status: 'lead',
          source: null,
          assignedTo: null,
          createdAt: new Date('2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'),
        },
      ]);

      const csv = await service.customersCsv({} as any);

      expect(csv).toContain(
        'KH-0001,Công ty A,company,active,website,Nguyễn A,2026-01-15',
      );
      expect(csv).toContain('KH-0002,Công ty B,company,lead,,,2026-02-01');
    });
  });

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // sales()
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('sales', () => {
    it('computes stage totals, revenue trend, department breakdown, and win rate', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { stage: 'closed_won', _count: { _all: 3 }, _sum: { value: 900 } },
        { stage: 'closed_lost', _count: { _all: 1 }, _sum: { value: null } },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: 300 },
        _count: { _all: 1 },
      });
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: 'd1', name: 'Kinh doanh' },
        { id: 'd2', name: 'Kỹ thuật' },
      ]);

      const result = await service.sales({ months: 2 } as any);

      const won = result.byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_won');
      const lost = result.byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_lost');
      const untouched = result.byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'prospecting');
      expect(won).toEqual({ stage: 'closed_won', count: 3, value: 900 });
      expect(lost).toEqual({ stage: 'closed_lost', count: 1, value: 0 });
      expect(untouched).toEqual({ stage: 'prospecting', count: 0, value: 0 });

      expect(result.winRate).toBe(75); // 3 / (3+1)
      expect(result.wonCount).toBe(3);
      expect(result.wonValue).toBe(900);

      expect(result.revenueByMonth).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(result.revenueByMonth[0]).toEqual({
        month: expect.any(String),
        revenue: 300,
        wonCount: 1,
      });

      expect(result.byDepartment).toEqual([
        {
          departmentId: 'd1',
          departmentName: 'Kinh doanh',
          revenue: 300,
          wonCount: 1,
        },
        {
          departmentId: 'd2',
          departmentName: 'Kỹ thuật',
          revenue: 300,
          wonCount: 1,
        },
      ]);
    });

    it('returns zeroed-out results when there are no deals or departments', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: null },
        _count: { _all: 0 },
      });
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.sales({ months: 1 } as any);

      expect(result.winRate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.wonCount).toBe(0);
      expect(result.byDepartment).toEqual([]);
      expect(result.revenueByMonth[0]).toEqual({
        month: expect.any(String),
        revenue: 0,
        wonCount: 0,
      });
    });

    it('defaults to a 6-month trend window when months is not specified', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: null },
        _count: { _all: 0 },
      });
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const result = await service.sales({} as any);

      expect(result.revenueByMonth).toHaveLength(6);
    });

    it('filters the department list to a single department when departmentId is given', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: null },
        _count: { _all: 0 },
      });
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: 'd1', name: 'Kinh doanh' },
      ]);

      await service.sales({ months: 1, departmentId: 'd1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.department.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { deletedAt: null, id: 'd1' },
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      });
    });

    it('scopes by employeeId via the shared assignee filter', async () => {
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.deal.aggregate.mockResolvedValue({
        _sum: { value: null },
        _count: { _all: 0 },
      });
      prisma.department.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      await service.sales({ months: 1, employeeId: 'e1' } as any);

      expect(prisma.deal.groupBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { deletedAt: null, assignedToId: 'e1' },
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('salesCsv', () => {
    it('renders a CSV with one row per deal', async () => {
      prisma.deal.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          code: 'CH-0001',
          name: 'Hợp đồng A',
          customer: { name: 'Công ty A' },
          stage: 'closed_won',
          status: 'won',
          value: 900,
          assignedTo: { fullName: 'Nguyễn A' },
          createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
          closedAt: new Date('2026-01-20T00:00:00Z'),
        },
        {
          code: 'CH-0002',
          name: 'Hợp đồng B',
          customer: null,
          stage: 'prospecting',

      expect(csv).toContain(

      );
      expect(csv).toContain(
        'CH-0002,Hợp đồng B,,prospecting,open,0,,2026-02-01,',

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // employeePerformance() / employeePerformanceCsv()
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe('employeePerformance', () => {

          fullName: 'B',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: null,
        },
        {
          id: 'e3',
          code: 'NV3',
          fullName: 'C',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: { id: 'd1', name: 'KD' },
        },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _sum: { value: 100 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
        { assignedToId: 'e3', _sum: { value: 500 }, _count: { _all: 2 } },
      ]);
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockImplementation(({ where }: any) => {
        if (where.status === 'done') {
          return Promise.resolve([{ assignedToId: 'e1', _count: { _all: 3 } }]);
        }
        return Promise.resolve([
          { assignedToId: 'e1', _count: { _all: 5 } },
          { assignedToId: 'e2', _count: { _all: 2 } },
        ]);
      });
    };

    it('ranks by revenue by default and paginates the result', async () => {
      mockThreeEmployees();

      const result = await service.employeePerformance({
        months: 1,
        pageSize: 2,
        page: 1,
      } as any);

      expect(result.total).toBe(3);
      expect(result.totalPages).toBe(2);
      expect(result.data.map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(['e3', 'e1']);
      expect(result.data[1].completionRate).toBe(60); // e1: 3/5
      expect(result.data.find((r) => r.id === 'e1')?.department).toEqual({
        id: 'd1',
        name: 'KD',
      });
    });

    it('ranks by tasksCompleted when sortBy is set', async () => {
      mockThreeEmployees();

      const result = await service.employeePerformance({
        months: 1,
        sortBy: 'tasksCompleted',
        pageSize: 10,
        page: 1,
      } as any);

      expect(result.data[0].id).toBe('e1'); // only one with tasksCompleted > 0
    });

    it('ranks by completionRate when sortBy is set', async () => {
      mockThreeEmployees();

      const result = await service.employeePerformance({
        months: 1,
        sortBy: 'completionRate',
        pageSize: 10,
        page: 1,
      } as any);

      expect(result.data[0].id).toBe('e1'); // 60%, the others are 0%
    });

    it('gives an employee with no assigned tasks a completionRate of 0', async () => {
      mockThreeEmployees();

      const result = await service.employeePerformance({
        months: 1,
        pageSize: 10,
        page: 1,
      } as any);
      const e3 = result.data.find((r) => r.id === 'e3')!;
      expect(e3.tasksAssigned).toBe(0);
      expect(e3.completionRate).toBe(0);
    });

    it('filters employees by employeeId and departmentId', async () => {
      mockThreeEmployees();

      await service.employeePerformance({
        months: 1,
        employeeId: 'e1',
        departmentId: 'd1',
      } as any);

      expect(prisma.employee.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { archivedAt: null, id: 'e1', departmentId: 'd1' },
        }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('employeePerformanceCsv', () => {
    it('renders a CSV sorted by revenue', async () => {
      prisma.employee.findMany.mockResolvedValue([
        {
          id: 'e1',
          code: 'NV1',
          fullName: 'A',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: { id: 'd1', name: 'KD' },
        },
        {
          id: 'e2',
          code: 'NV2',
          fullName: 'B',
          avatarUrl: null,
          department: null,
        },
      ]);
      prisma.deal.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { assignedToId: 'e1', _sum: { value: 100 }, _count: { _all: 1 } },
      ]);
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);

      const csv = await service.employeePerformanceCsv({ months: 1 } as any);

      expect(csv).toContain('NV1,A,KD,1,100,0,0,0');
      expect(csv).toContain('NV2,B,,0,0,0,0,0');
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/reports/reports.service.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { toCsv } from '../common/utils/csv.util';
import {
  QueryPerformanceReportDto,
  QueryReportDto,
} from './dto/query-report.dto';

interface MonthBucket {
  gte: Date;
  lt: Date;
  label: string;
}

export interface PerformanceRow {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  fullName: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
  department: { id: string; name: string } | null;
  dealsWonCount: number;
  revenue: number;
  tasksCompleted: number;
  tasksAssigned: number;
  completionRate: number;
}

const ALL_STAGES = [
  'prospecting',
  'qualification',
  'proposal',
  'negotiation',
  'closed_won',
  'closed_lost',
];

@Injectable()
export class ReportsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** Sinh N mốc tháng gần nhất (bao gồm tháng hiện tại), theo thứ tự tăng dần */
  private lastMonths(count: number): MonthBucket[] {
    const now = new Date();
    const buckets: MonthBucket[] = [];
    for (let i = count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const year = now.getUTCFullYear();
      const monthIndex = now.getUTCMonth() - i;
      const gte = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex, 1));
      const lt = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex + 1, 1));
      const label = `${gte.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(gte.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      buckets.push({ gte, lt, label });
    }
    return buckets;
  }

  private assigneeFilter(employeeId?: string, departmentId?: string) {
    if (employeeId) return { assignedToId: employeeId };
    if (departmentId) return { assignedTo: { departmentId } };
    return {};
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Báo cáo khách hàng
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async customers(query: QueryReportDto) {
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);
    const months = this.lastMonths(query.months ?? 6);

    const [byStatusRaw, byTypeRaw, bySourceRaw, monthlyNew] = await Promise.all(
      [
        this.prisma.customer.groupBy({
          by: ['status'],
          where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
          _count: { _all: true },
        }),
        this.prisma.customer.groupBy({
          by: ['type'],
          where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
          _count: { _all: true },
        }),
        this.prisma.customer.groupBy({
          by: ['source'],
          where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
          _count: { _all: true },
        }),
        Promise.all(
          months.map(async (m) => ({
            month: m.label,
            count: await this.prisma.customer.count({
              where: {
                deletedAt: null,
                ...assignee,
                createdAt: { gte: m.gte, lt: m.lt },
              },
            }),
          })),
        ),
      ],
    );

    const total = byStatusRaw.reduce((s, g) => s + g._count._all, 0);

    return {
      total,
      byStatus: byStatusRaw.map((g) => ({
        status: g.status,
        count: g._count._all,
      })),
      byType: byTypeRaw.map((g) => ({ type: g.type, count: g._count._all })),
      bySource: bySourceRaw.map((g) => ({
        source: g.source ?? 'Không xác định',
        count: g._count._all,
      })),
      monthlyNew,
    };
  }

  async customersCsv(query: QueryReportDto): Promise<string> {
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);
    const rows = await this.prisma.customer.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
      include: { assignedTo: { select: { fullName: true } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return toCsv(
      [
        'Mã KH',
        'Tên khách hàng',
        'Loại',
        'Trạng thái',
        'Nguồn',
        'Người phụ trách',
        'Ngày tạo',
      ],
      rows.map((c) => [
        c.code,
        c.name,
        c.type,
        c.status,
        c.source ?? '',
        c.assignedTo?.fullName ?? '',
        c.createdAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Báo cáo doanh số
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  async sales(query: QueryReportDto) {
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);
    const months = this.lastMonths(query.months ?? 6);

    const [byStageRaw, revenueByMonth, departments] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.deal.groupBy({
        by: ['stage'],
        where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
        _count: { _all: true },
        _sum: { value: true },
      }),
      Promise.all(
        months.map(async (m) => {
          const agg = await this.prisma.deal.aggregate({
            where: {
              deletedAt: null,
              stage: 'closed_won',
              ...assignee,
              closedAt: { gte: m.gte, lt: m.lt },
            },
            _sum: { value: true },
            _count: { _all: true },
          });
          return {
            month: m.label,
            revenue: agg._sum.value ? Number(agg._sum.value) : 0,
            wonCount: agg._count._all,
          };
        }),
      ),
      this.prisma.department.findMany({
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          ...(query.departmentId ? { id: query.departmentId } : {}),
        },
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      }),
    ]);

    const byStage = ALL_STAGES.map((stage) => {
      const g = byStageRaw.find((x) => x.stage === stage);
      return {
        stage,
        count: g?._count._all ?? 0,
        value: g?._sum.value ? Number(g._sum.value) : 0,
      };
    });

    const won = byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_won')!;
    const lost = byStage.find((s) => s.stage === 'closed_lost')!;
    const closedTotal = won.count + lost.count;
    const winRate =
      closedTotal > 0 ? Math.round((won.count / closedTotal) * 100) : 0;

    const range = { gte: months[0].gte, lt: months[months.length - 1].lt };
    const byDepartment = await Promise.all(
      departments.map(async (d) => {
        const agg = await this.prisma.deal.aggregate({
          where: {
            deletedAt: null,
            stage: 'closed_won',
            assignedTo: { departmentId: d.id },
            closedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt },
          },
          _sum: { value: true },
          _count: { _all: true },
        });
        return {
          departmentId: d.id,
          departmentName: d.name,
          revenue: agg._sum.value ? Number(agg._sum.value) : 0,
          wonCount: agg._count._all,
        };
      }),
    );

    return {
      byStage,
      revenueByMonth,
      byDepartment,
      winRate,
      wonCount: won.count,
      wonValue: won.value,
    };
  }

  async salesCsv(query: QueryReportDto): Promise<string> {
    const assignee = this.assigneeFilter(query.employeeId, query.departmentId);
    const rows = await this.prisma.deal.findMany({
      where: { deletedAt: null, ...assignee },
      include: {
        customer: { select: { name: true } },
        assignedTo: { select: { fullName: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return toCsv(
      [
        'Mã CH',
        'Tên cơ hội',
        'Khách hàng',
        'Giai đoạn',
        'Trạng thái',
        'Giá trị',
        'Người phụ trách',
        'Ngày tạo',
        'Ngày đóng',
      ],
      rows.map((d) => [
        d.code,
        d.name,
        d.customer?.name ?? '',
        d.stage,
        d.status,
        d.value != null ? Number(d.value) : 0,
        d.assignedTo?.fullName ?? '',
        d.createdAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        d.closedAt ? d.closedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '',
      ]),
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Báo cáo hiệu suất nhân viên
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  private async buildPerformanceRows(
    query: QueryReportDto | QueryPerformanceReportDto,
  ): Promise<PerformanceRow[]> {
    const months = this.lastMonths(query.months ?? 6);
    const range = { gte: months[0].gte, lt: months[months.length - 1].lt };

    const employeeWhere: any = { archivedAt: null };
    if (query.employeeId) employeeWhere.id = query.employeeId;
    if (query.departmentId) employeeWhere.departmentId = query.departmentId;

    const employees = await this.prisma.employee.findMany({
      where: employeeWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        code: true,
        fullName: true,
        avatarUrl: true,
        department: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { fullName: 'asc' },
    });
    const employeeIds = employees.map((e) => e.id);
    if (employeeIds.length === 0) return [];

    const [dealsWon, tasksCompleted, tasksAssigned] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.deal.groupBy({
        by: ['assignedToId'],
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          stage: 'closed_won',
          assignedToId: { in: employeeIds },
          closedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt },
        },
        _sum: { value: true },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.task.groupBy({
        by: ['assignedToId'],
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          status: 'done',
          assignedToId: { in: employeeIds },
          completedAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt },
        },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.task.groupBy({
        by: ['assignedToId'],
        where: {
          deletedAt: null,
          assignedToId: { in: employeeIds },
          createdAt: { gte: range.gte, lt: range.lt },
        },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
    ]);

    return employees.map((e) => {
      const deal = dealsWon.find((d) => d.assignedToId === e.id);
      const done = tasksCompleted.find((t) => t.assignedToId === e.id);
      const assigned = tasksAssigned.find((t) => t.assignedToId === e.id);
      const tasksCompletedCount = done?._count._all ?? 0;
      const tasksAssignedCount = assigned?._count._all ?? 0;
      return {
        id: e.id,
        code: e.code,
        fullName: e.fullName,
        avatarUrl: e.avatarUrl,
        department: e.department
          ? { id: e.department.id, name: e.department.name }
          : null,
        dealsWonCount: deal?._count._all ?? 0,
        revenue: deal?._sum.value ? Number(deal._sum.value) : 0,
        tasksCompleted: tasksCompletedCount,
        tasksAssigned: tasksAssignedCount,
        completionRate:
          tasksAssignedCount > 0
            ? Math.round((tasksCompletedCount / tasksAssignedCount) * 100)
            : 0,
      };
    });
  }

  private sortPerformance<
    T extends {
      revenue: number;
      tasksCompleted: number;
      completionRate: number;
    },
  >(rows: T[], sortBy: 'revenue' | 'tasksCompleted' | 'completionRate'): T[] {
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'tasksCompleted')
        return b.tasksCompleted - a.tasksCompleted;
      if (sortBy === 'completionRate')
        return b.completionRate - a.completionRate;
      return b.revenue - a.revenue;
    });
  }

  async employeePerformance(query: QueryPerformanceReportDto) {
    const rows = await this.buildPerformanceRows(query);
    const sortBy = query.sortBy ?? 'revenue';
    const sorted = this.sortPerformance(rows, sortBy);

    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.pageSize ?? 20;
    const total = sorted.length;
    const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    return {
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
      data: sorted.slice(start, start + pageSize),
    };
  }

  async employeePerformanceCsv(query: QueryReportDto): Promise<string> {
    const rows = await this.buildPerformanceRows(query);
    const sorted = this.sortPerformance(rows, 'revenue');

    return toCsv(
      [
        'Mã NV',
        'Họ tên',
        'Phòng ban',
        'Cơ hội thắng',
        'Doanh số',
        'Công việc hoàn thành',
        'Công việc được giao',
        'Tỷ lệ hoàn thành (%)',
      ],
      sorted.map((r) => [
        r.code,
        r.fullName,
        r.department?.name ?? '',
        r.dealsWonCount,
        r.revenue,
        r.tasksCompleted,
        r.tasksAssigned,
        r.completionRate,
      ]),
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { TaskLibraryController } from './task-library.controller';
import { TaskLibraryService } from './task-library.service';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

describe('TaskLibraryController', () => {
  let controller: TaskLibraryController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  const reflector = new Reflector();

  const user: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'user-1',
    email: 'user1@b.com',
    roles: ['manager'],
    permissions: ['task_library:create:all'],
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      createTemplate: jest.fn(),
      findAllTemplates: jest.fn(),
      findOneTemplate: jest.fn(),
      updateTemplate: jest.fn(),
      removeTemplate: jest.fn(),
      createTask: jest.fn(),
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      updateTask: jest.fn(),
      updateProgress: jest.fn(),
      removeTask: jest.fn(),
      stats: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [TaskLibraryController],
      providers: [{ provide: TaskLibraryService, useValue: service }],
    }).compile();

    controller = module.get(TaskLibraryController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  describe('template routes delegate to service', () => {
    it('createTemplate() delegates with the dto', async () => {
      service.createTemplate.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { name: 'Onboarding' } as any;
      await controller.createTemplate(dto);
      expect(service.createTemplate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto);
    });

    it('findAllTemplates() delegates', async () => {
      service.findAllTemplates.mockResolvedValue([]);
      await controller.findAllTemplates();
      expect(service.findAllTemplates).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('findOneTemplate() delegates with id', async () => {
      service.findOneTemplate.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      await controller.findOneTemplate('1');
      expect(service.findOneTemplate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });

    it('updateTemplate() delegates with id and dto', async () => {
      service.updateTemplate.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      const dto = { name: 'Updated' } as any;
      await controller.updateTemplate('1', dto);
      expect(service.updateTemplate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1', dto);
    });

    it('removeTemplate() delegates with id', async () => {
      service.removeTemplate.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });
      await controller.removeTemplate('1');
      expect(service.removeTemplate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('1');
    });
  });

  describe('task routes delegate to service', () => {
    it('createTask() passes the dto and the authenticated user id', async () => {
      service.createTask.mockResolvedValue({ id: 't1' });
      const dto = { title: 'Task', assignedToId: 'emp-1' } as any;

      await controller.createTask(dto, user);

      expect(service.createTask).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto, 'user-1');
    });

    it('findAllTasks() delegates with query', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [] });
      const query = { status: 'pending' } as any;
      await controller.findAllTasks(query);
      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(query);
    });

    it('findOneTask() delegates with id', async () => {
      service.findOne.mockResolvedValue({ id: 't1' });
      await controller.findOneTask('t1');
      expect(service.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('t1');
    });

    it('updateTask() delegates with id and dto', async () => {
      service.updateTask.mockResolvedValue({ id: 't1' });
      const dto = { status: 'done' } as any;
      await controller.updateTask('t1', dto);
      expect(service.updateTask).toHaveBeenCalledWith('t1', dto);
    });

    it('updateProgress() extracts progress from the body and delegates', async () => {
      service.updateProgress.mockResolvedValue({ id: 't1', progress: 75 });
      await controller.updateProgress('t1', { progress: 75 });
      expect(service.updateProgress).toHaveBeenCalledWith('t1', 75);
    });

    it('removeTask() delegates with id', async () => {
      service.removeTask.mockResolvedValue({ success: true });
      await controller.removeTask('t1');
      expect(service.removeTask).toHaveBeenCalledWith('t1');
    });

    it('getStats() forwards the optional employeeId query param', async () => {
      service.stats.mockResolvedValue({ total: 0 });
      await controller.getStats('emp-1');
      expect(service.stats).toHaveBeenCalledWith('emp-1');
    });

    it('getStats() works with no employeeId provided', async () => {
      service.stats.mockResolvedValue({ total: 0 });
      await controller.getStats();
      expect(service.stats).toHaveBeenCalledWith(undefined);
    });
  });

  describe('RBAC metadata (roles required per route)', () => {
    it('restricts template mutation routes to admin and hr', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.createTemplate)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.updateTemplate)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.removeTemplate)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'hr',
      ]);
    });

    it('allows admin, manager and hr to create tasks', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.createTask)).toEqual([
        'admin',
        'manager',
        'hr',
      ]);
    });

    it('leaves task read/update/progress routes unrestricted at the controller level (any authenticated user)', () => {
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.findAllTasks)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.updateTask)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(
        reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.updateProgress),
      ).toBeUndefined();
      expect(reflector.get(ROLES_KEY, controller.removeTask)).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/task-library/task-library.controller.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Patch,
  Delete,
  Param,
  Body,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiTags,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { TaskLibraryService } from './task-library.service';
import { CreateTaskTemplateDto } from './dto/create-task-template.dto';
import { UpdateTaskTemplateDto } from './dto/update-task-template.dto';
import { CreateTaskDto } from './dto/create-task.dto';
import { UpdateTaskDto } from './dto/update-task.dto';
import { QueryTaskDto } from './dto/query-task.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  RequestUser,
} from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

@ApiTags('task-library')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('task-library')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
export class TaskLibraryController {
  constructor(private readonly taskLibraryService: TaskLibraryService) {}

  // ===== TASK TEMPLATES =====

  @Post('templates')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Tạo mẫu công việc mới (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  async createTemplate(@Body() dto: CreateTaskTemplateDto) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.createTemplate(dto);
  }

  @Get('templates')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Danh sách mẫu công việc đang hoạt động' })
  async findAllTemplates() {
    return this.taskLibraryService.findAllTemplates();
  }

  @Get('templates/:id')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Chi tiết một mẫu công việc (kèm các task đã tạo từ mẫu)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Không tìm thấy mẫu' })
  async findOneTemplate(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.findOneTemplate(id);
  }

  @Patch('templates/:id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cập nhật mẫu công việc (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  async updateTemplate(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdateTaskTemplateDto,
  ) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.updateTemplate(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete('templates/:id')
  @Roles('admin', 'hr')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Vô hiệu hóa mẫu công việc (chỉ admin/hr)' })
  async removeTemplate(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.removeTemplate(id);
  }

  // ===== TASKS =====

  @Post('tasks')
  @Roles('admin', 'manager', 'hr')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Tạo công việc mới, sinh mã tự động TASK-XXXXX (admin/manager/hr)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Nhân viên được giao không tồn tại',
  })
  async createTask(
    @Body() dto: CreateTaskDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.createTask(dto, user.userId);
  }

  @Get('tasks')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary:
      'Danh sách công việc (phân trang, tìm kiếm, lọc trạng thái/ưu tiên/người phụ trách)',
  })
  async findAllTasks(@Query() query: QueryTaskDto) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('tasks/:id')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Chi tiết một công việc' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Không tìm thấy công việc' })
  async findOneTask(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Patch('tasks/:id')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Cập nhật công việc (tự động hoàn tất khi status=done)',
  })
  async updateTask(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() dto: UpdateTaskDto) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.updateTask(id, dto);
  }

  @Patch('tasks/:id/progress')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Cập nhật tiến độ 0-100%, tự động chuyển done khi đạt 100%',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: 'Tiến độ ngoài khoảng 0-100' })
  async updateProgress(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() body: { progress: number },
  ) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.updateProgress(id, body.progress);
  }

  @Delete('tasks/:id')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Xóa mềm công việc' })
  async removeTask(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.removeTask(id);
  }

  @Get('tasks/stats/dashboard')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Thống kê công việc theo trạng thái và số lượng quá hạn',
  })
  async getStats(@Query('employeeId') employeeId?: string) {
    return this.taskLibraryService.stats(employeeId);
  }
}
```

```typescript
      await service.updateTask('1', {

      const callArg = prisma.task.update.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(callArg.data).toEqual({ title: 'New title' });

  describe('updateProgress', () => {
    it('throws BadRequestException for progress below 0', async () => {
      await expect(service.updateProgress('1', -5)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('throws BadRequestException for progress above 100', async () => {
      await expect(service.updateProgress('1', 150)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
    });

    it('throws NotFoundException when task does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.task.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.updateProgress('missing', 50)).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('auto-marks task done and sets completedAt when progress reaches 100', async () => {
      prisma.task.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        status: 'in_progress',
      });
      prisma.task.update.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        status: 'done',
        progress: 100,
      });

      await service.updateProgress('1', 100);

      expect(prisma.task.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            progress: 100,
            status: 'done',
            completedAt: expect.any(Date),
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('does not change status when progress is under 100', async () => {
      prisma.task.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
        id: '1',
        status: 'in_progress',
      });
      prisma.task.update.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1', progress: 50 });

      await service.updateProgress('1', 50);

      const callArg = prisma.task.update.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(callArg.data).toEqual({ progress: 50 });
    });
  });

  describe('removeTask', () => {
    it('throws NotFoundException when task does not exist', async () => {
      prisma.task.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.removeTask('missing')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException,
      );
    });

    it('soft-deletes the task', async () => {
      prisma.task.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' });
      prisma.task.update.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await service.removeTask('1');

      expect(prisma.task.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: '1' },
        data: { deletedAt: expect.any(Date) },
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('stats', () => {
    it('aggregates task counts by status and overdue count', async () => {
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([
        { status: 'pending', _count: { _all: 3 } },
        { status: 'done', _count: { _all: 5 } },
      ]);
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(2);

      const result = await service.stats();

      expect(result.total).toBe(8);
      expect(result.byStatus.pending).toBe(3);
      expect(result.byStatus.done).toBe(5);
      expect(result.overdue).toBe(2);
    });

    it('scopes stats to a specific employee when employeeId is given', async () => {
      prisma.task.groupBy.mockResolvedValue([]);
      prisma.task.count.mockResolvedValue(0);

      await service.stats('emp-1');

      expect(prisma.task.groupBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: expect.objectContaining({ assignedToId: 'emp-1' }),
        }),
      );
    });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/task-library/task-library.service.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateTaskTemplateDto } from './dto/create-task-template.dto';
import { UpdateTaskTemplateDto } from './dto/update-task-template.dto';
import { CreateTaskDto } from './dto/create-task.dto';
import { UpdateTaskDto } from './dto/update-task.dto';
import { QueryTaskDto } from './dto/query-task.dto';

@Injectable()
export class TaskLibraryService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  // ===== TASK TEMPLATES =====

  /** Generate task template code: TMPL-0001 */
  private async nextTemplateCode(): Promise<string> {
    const last = await this.prisma.taskTemplate.findFirst({
      where: { code: { startsWith: 'TMPL-' } },
      orderBy: { code: 'desc' },
    });
    const n = last ? parseInt(last.code.replace('TMPL-', ''), 10) + 1 : 1;
    return `TMPL-${String(n).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  }

  async createTemplate(dto: CreateTaskTemplateDto) {
    const code = await this.nextTemplateCode();

    const template = await this.prisma.taskTemplate.create({
      data: {
        code,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description ?? null,
        category: dto.category ?? null,
        priority: dto.priority ?? 'medium',
        estimatedDays: dto.estimatedDays ?? 1,
        isActive: dto.isActive ?? true,
      },
    });

    return template;
  }

  async findAllTemplates() {
    return this.prisma.taskTemplate.findMany({
      where: { isActive: true },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOneTemplate(id: string) {
    const template = await this.prisma.taskTemplate.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { tasks: { where: { deletedAt: null } } },
    });

    if (!template) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template không tồn tại.');
    }

    return template;
  }

  async updateTemplate(id: string, dto: UpdateTaskTemplateDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.taskTemplate.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template không tồn tại.');
    }

    const data: any = {};
    const assignable: (keyof UpdateTaskTemplateDto)[] = [
      'name',
      'description',
      'category',
      'priority',
      'estimatedDays',
      'isActive',
    ];

    for (const key of assignable) {
      if (dto[key] !== undefined) {
        data[key] = dto[key];
      }
    }

    return this.prisma.taskTemplate.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
    });
  }

  async removeTemplate(id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.taskTemplate.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template không tồn tại.');
    }

    await this.prisma.taskTemplate.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isActive: false },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa template.' };
  }

  // ===== TASKS =====

  /** Generate task code: TASK-00001 */
  private async nextTaskCode(): Promise<string> {
    const last = await this.prisma.task.findFirst({
      where: { code: { startsWith: 'TASK-' } },
      orderBy: { code: 'desc' },
    });
    const n = last ? parseInt(last.code.replace('TASK-', ''), 10) + 1 : 1;
    return `TASK-${String(n).padStart(5, '0')}`;
  }

  private async validateAssignee(assignedToId: string) {
    const emp = await this.prisma.employee.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignedToId },
    });
    if (!emp) throw new BadRequestException('Nhân viên không tồn tại.');
  }

  async createTask(dto: CreateTaskDto, createdById?: string) {
    await this.validateAssignee(dto.assignedToId);

    const code = await this.nextTaskCode();

    const task = await this.prisma.task.create({
      data: {
        code,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description ?? null,
        templateId: dto.templateId ?? null,
        assignedToId: dto.assignedToId,
        priority: dto.priority ?? 'medium',
        status: 'pending',
        progress: 0,
        dueDate: dto.dueDate ?? null,
        createdById: createdById ?? null,
      },
      include: {
        assignedTo: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        template: true,
        createdBy: { select: { id: true, email: true } },
      },
    });

    return task;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryTaskDto) {
    const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
    const pageSize = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.pageSize) || 20, 1), 100);
    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { deletedAt: null };

    if (query.status) where.status = query.status;
    if (query.priority) where.priority = query.priority;
    if (query.assignedToId) where.assignedToId = query.assignedToId;

    if (query.search && query.search.trim()) {
      const term = query.search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { title: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { code: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { description: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const sortBy = query.sortBy ?? 'createdAt';
    const sortOrder = query.sortOrder ?? 'desc';
    const orderBy: any = {
      [sortBy]: sortOrder,
    };

    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.task.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          assignedTo: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
          template: true,
          createdBy: { select: { id: true, email: true } },
        },
        orderBy,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
      }),
      this.prisma.task.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: rows,
      total,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize) || 1,
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const task = await this.prisma.task.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        assignedTo: true,
        template: true,
        createdBy: { select: { id: true, email: true } },
      },
    });

    if (!task) throw new NotFoundException('Task không tồn tại.');

    return task;
  }

  async updateTask(id: string, dto: UpdateTaskDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.task.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Task không tồn tại.');

    if (dto.assignedToId) {
      await this.validateAssignee(dto.assignedToId);
    }

    const data: any = {};
    const assignable: (keyof UpdateTaskDto)[] = [
      'title',
      'description',
      'priority',
      'status',
      'progress',
      'dueDate',
    ];

    for (const key of assignable) {
      if (dto[key] !== undefined) {
        data[key] = dto[key];
      }
    }

    if (dto.assignedToId !== undefined) {
      data.assignedTo = { connect: { id: dto.assignedToId } };
    }

    // Auto mark as done if status is 'done'
    if (dto.status === 'done' && !existing.completedAt) {
      data.completedAt = new Date();
      data.progress = 100;
    }

    return this.prisma.task.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
      include: {
        assignedTo: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
        template: true,
      },
    });
  }

  async updateProgress(id: string, progress: number) {
    if (progress < 0 || progress > 100) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Progress phải từ 0 đến 100.');
    }

    const task = await this.prisma.task.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!task) throw new NotFoundException('Task không tồn tại.');

    const data: any = { progress };
    if (progress === 100 && task.status !== 'done') {
      data.status = 'done';
      data.completedAt = new Date();
    }

    return this.prisma.task.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
      include: {
        assignedTo: { select: { id: true, code: true, fullName: true } },
      },
    });
  }

  async removeTask(id: string) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.task.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Task không tồn tại.');

    await this.prisma.task.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date() },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Đã xóa task.' };
  }

  // ===== DASHBOARD STATS =====

  async stats(employeeId?: string) {
    const where: any = { deletedAt: null };

    if (employeeId) {
      where.assignedToId = employeeId;
    }

    const grouped = await this.prisma.task.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      where,
      _count: { _all: true },
    });

    const byStatus: Record<string, number> = {
      pending: 0,
      in_progress: 0,
      done: 0,
      overdue: 0,
    };

    let total = 0;
    for (const g of grouped) {
      byStatus[g.status] = g._count._all;
      total += g._count._all;
    }

    // Count overdue tasks
    const overdueTasks = await this.prisma.task.count({
      where: {
        ...where,
        status: { notIn: ['done'] },
        dueDate: { lt: new Date() },
      },
    });

    return {
      total,
      byStatus,
      overdue: overdueTasks,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {

  IsIn,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  MinLength,
} from 'class-validator';
import { RoleName } from '@comtech/types';

const ROLE_NAMES: RoleName[] = [
  'admin',
  'manager',
  'employee',
  'hr',
  'hr_manager',
];

export class CreateUserDto {
  @IsEmail({}, { message: 'Email không hợp lệ.' })
  email: string;

  @IsString()
  @MinLength(8, { message: 'Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 8 ký tự.' })
  password: string;

  @IsString({ message: 'Vui lòng nhập họ tên.' })
  @MinLength(2, { message: 'Họ tên quá ngắn.' })
  fullName: string;

  @IsIn(ROLE_NAMES, { message: 'Vai trò không hợp lệ.' })
  roleName: RoleName;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUUID('4', { message: 'Phòng ban không hợp lệ.' })
  departmentId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  jobTitle?: string;
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { UsersController } from './users.controller';
import { UsersService } from './users.service';
import type { RequestUser } from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

describe('UsersController', () => {
  let controller: UsersController;
  let service: Record<string, jest.Mock>;

  const user: RequestUser = {
    userId: 'admin-1',
    email: 'admin@b.com',
    roles: ['admin'],
    permissions: ['users:read:all', 'users:create:all', 'users:update:all'],
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    service = {
      getMe: jest.fn(),
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn(),
      lock: jest.fn(),
      unlock: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [UsersController],
      providers: [{ provide: UsersService, useValue: service }],
    }).compile();

    controller = module.get(UsersController);
  });

  afterEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  it('delegates getMe() to the service with the current user id', async () => {
    service.getMe.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'admin-1' });
    const result = await controller.getMe(user);
    expect(service.getMe).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin-1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'admin-1' });
  });

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('defaults page/pageSize when the query params are absent', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], total: 0 });
      await controller.findAll(undefined, undefined);
      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1, 20);
    });

    it('parses page/pageSize from query strings', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], total: 0 });
      await controller.findAll('2', '50');
      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(2, 50);
    });

    it('falls back to defaults for non-numeric query params', async () => {
      service.findAll.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], total: 0 });
      await controller.findAll('abc', 'xyz');
      expect(service.findAll).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1, 20);
    });
  });

  it('delegates findOne() to the service', async () => {
    service.findOne.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'u1' });
    const result = await controller.findOne('u1');
    expect(service.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('u1');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'u1' });
  });

  it('delegates create() to the service with the current admin as actor', async () => {
    const dto = {
      email: 'x@y.com',
      password: 'pw',
      fullName: 'X',
      roleName: 'employee',
    } as any;
    service.create.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'new-1' });

    const result = await controller.create(dto, user);

    expect(service.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(dto, 'admin-1', 'admin@b.com');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'new-1' });
  });

  it('delegates lock() to the service with the current admin as actor', async () => {
    service.lock.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'u1', isLocked: true });

    const result = await controller.lock(
      'u1',
      { reason: 'Vi phạm' } as any,
      user,
    );

    expect(service.lock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'u1',
      'Vi phạm',
      'admin-1',
      'admin@b.com',
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'u1', isLocked: true });
  });

  it('delegates unlock() to the service with the current admin as actor', async () => {
    service.unlock.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'u1', isLocked: false });

    const result = await controller.unlock('u1', user);

    expect(service.unlock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('u1', 'admin-1', 'admin@b.com');
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'u1', isLocked: false });
  });
});
```

### `apps/api/src/users/users.controller.ts`

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { UsersService } from './users.service';
import { CreateUserDto } from './dto/create-user.dto';
import { LockUserDto } from './dto/lock-user.dto';
import { Roles } from '../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { RequirePermissions } from '../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  RequestUser,
} from '../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';

@ApiTags('users')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('users')
export class UsersController {
  constructor(private readonly usersService: UsersService) {}

  // GET /api/users/me — thông tin người dùng hiện tại (mọi vai trò đã đăng nhập)
  @Get('me')
  getMe(@CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.usersService.getMe(user.userId);
  }

  // GET /api/users — Admin only
  @Get()
  @Roles('admin')
  @RequirePermissions('users:read')
  findAll(@Query('page') page?: string, @Query('pageSize') pageSize?: string) {
    return this.usersService.findAll(Number(page) || 1, Number(pageSize) || 20);
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @Roles('admin')
  @RequirePermissions('users:read')
  findOne(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.usersService.findOne(id);
  }

  // POST /api/users — Admin only
  @Post()
  @Roles('admin')
  @RequirePermissions('users:create')
  create(@Body() dto: CreateUserDto, @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser) {
    return this.usersService.create(dto, user.userId, user.email);
  }

  // PATCH /api/users/:id/lock — Admin only
  @Patch(':id/lock')
  @Roles('admin')
  @RequirePermissions('users:update')
  lock(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: LockUserDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.usersService.lock(id, dto.reason, user.userId, user.email);
  }

  // PATCH /api/users/:id/unlock — Admin only
  @Patch(':id/unlock')
  @Roles('admin')
  @RequirePermissions('users:update')
  unlock(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: RequestUser,
  ) {
    return this.usersService.unlock(id, user.userId, user.email);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { UsersService } from './users.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';

jest.mock('bcrypt', () => ({ hash: jest.fn() }));

type MockPrisma = {
  user: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  role: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  department: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  employee: Record<string, jest.Mock>;
  $transaction: jest.Mock;
};

describe('UsersService', () => {
  let service: UsersService;
  let prisma: MockPrisma;
  let audit: { log: jest.Mock };

  const userRow = (overrides: Partial<any> = {}) => ({
    id: 'u1',
    email: 'a@b.com',
    isActive: true,
    isLocked: false,
    lockedReason: null,
    lastLoginAt: null,
    createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01'),
    userRoles: [
      { role: { id: 'r1', name: 'employee', displayName: 'Nhân viên' } },
    ],
    employee: {
      id: 'emp1',
      code: 'NV-0001',
      fullName: 'Nguyễn Văn A',
      avatarUrl: null,
      jobTitle: 'Chuyên viên',
      departmentId: 'd1',
      status: 'active',
    },
    ...overrides,
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      user: {
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        create: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
      },
      role: { findUnique: jest.fn() },
      department: { findUnique: jest.fn() },
      employee: { findFirst: jest.fn() },
      $transaction: jest.fn((ops: Promise<any>[]) => Promise.all(ops)),
    };
    audit = { log: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        UsersService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
        { provide: AuditService, useValue: audit },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(UsersService);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    delete process.env.BCRYPT_COST;
  });

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('returns a paginated, mapped list', async () => {
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([userRow()]);
      prisma.user.count.mockResolvedValue(1);

      const result = await service.findAll(1, 20);

      expect(result.total).toBe(1);
      expect(result.data[0]).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({
          id: 'u1',
          email: 'a@b.com',
```
